The dev server\nserves the same files at the same paths, through the same app.publish code,\nso these tests read them over HTTP. Each test is named after the acceptance\nstep on #22 it checks.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom app import content as content_module\nfrom app import db as db_module\n\n\ndef _admin_id() -> int:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'admin@example.test'\"\n        ).fetchone()[\"id\"]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef _seed(kind: str, title: str, slug: str, body_md: str, status: str = \"published\") -> int:\n    content_id = content_module.create_content(kind, title, slug, body_md, _admin_id())\n    if status == \"published\":\n        content_module.set_status(content_id, kind, \"published\")\n    return content_id\n\n\n# -- Step 1: the index has the title, relative URL and a short excerpt of each\n#    published Post and Page --\n\ndef test_step1_the_index_lists_each_published_post_and_page(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"robotics-kickoff\", \"Meet us in room 204.\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"About us\", \"about-us\", \"We promote computer science.\")\n\n    response = client.get(\"/search-index.json\")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"application/json\")\n    assert response.json() == [\n        {\"title\": \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"url\": \"posts/robotics-kickoff.html\",\n         \"excerpt\": \"Meet us in room 204.\"},\n        {\"title\": \"About us\", \"url\": \"about-us.html\",\n         \"excerpt\": \"We promote computer science.\"},\n    ]\n\n\ndef test_step1_the_excerpt_is_short_plain_text(client):\n    body = (\"# Welcome\\n\\nJoin **CS Honor Society** & meet [our officers](/about-us.html).\"\n            \"\\n\\n<script>alert(1)</script>\\n\\n\" + \"lorem \" * 80)\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Welcome\", \"welcome\", body)\n\n    excerpt = client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json()[0][\"excerpt\"]\n\n Plain JavaScript, no library. Every URL is relative, because\n// GitHub Pages serves the site from a subfolder.\n(function () {\n  var input = document.getElementById(\"search-input\");\n  var status = document.getElementById(\"search-status\");\n  var results = document.getElementById(\"search-results\");\n  var index = null;\n\n  // Titles and excerpts are user content: build nodes with textContent,\n  // never innerHTML.\n  function result(entry) {\n    var link = document.createElement(\"a\");\n    link.className = \"post-card\";\n    link.href = entry.url;\n    var title = document.createElement(\"span\");\n    title.className = \"post-card__title\";\n    title.textContent = entry.title;\n    var excerpt = document.createElement(\"span\");\n    excerpt.className = \"post-card__excerpt\";\n    excerpt.textContent = entry.excerpt;\n    link.append(title, excerpt);\n    var item = document.createElement(\"li\");\n    item.append(link);\n    return item;\n  }\n\n  function show() {\n    var words = input.value.toLowerCase().split(/\\s+/).filter(Boolean);\n    results.replaceChildren();\n    if (index === null || words.length === 0) {\n      status.textContent = \"\";\n      return;\n    }\n    var hits = index.filter(function (entry) {\n      var text = (entry.title + \" \" + entry.excerpt).toLowerCase();\n      return words.every(function (word) { return text.indexOf(word) !== -1; });\n    });\n    results.append.apply(results, hits.map(result));\n    status.textContent = hits.length === 1 ? {"parentUuid":"6355a5e8-1d7c-44b4-b065-c0c66d237431","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"e8d65e77-511b-45bf-91ac-78dd6b784096","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01CS1PjNp9WevecXNRDE3VZh","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\app\\search.js (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"bc9455ff-02a6-4e72-b859-9bb16ce660a9","timestamp":"2026-10-21T04:36:25.879Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"create","filePath":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\app\\search.js","content":"// search.html's script: loads search-index.json (written by `cms publish`)\n// and lists every published Post and Page whose title or excerpt holds each\n// typed word. Plain JavaScript, no library. Every URL is relative, because\n// GitHub Pages serves the site from a subfolder.\n(function () {\n  var input = document.getElementById(\"search-input\");\n  var status = document.getElementById(\"search-status\");\n  var results = document.getElementById(\"search-results\");\n  var index = null;\n\n  // Titles and excerpts are user content: build nodes with textContent,\n  // never innerHTML.\n  function result(entry) {\n    var link = document.createElement(\"a\");\n    link.className = \"post-card\";\n    link.href = entry.url;\n    var title = document.createElement(\"span\");\n    title.className = \"post-card__title\";\n    title.textContent = entry.title;\n    var excerpt = document.createElement(\"span\");\n    excerpt.className = \"post-card__excerpt\";\n    excerpt.textContent = entry.excerpt;\n    link.append(title, excerpt);\n    var item = document.createElement(\"li\");\n    item.append(link);\n    return item;\n  }\n\n  function show() {\n    var words = input.value.toLowerCase().split(/\\s+/).filter(Boolean);\n    results.replaceChildren();\n    if (index === null || words.length === 0) {\n      status.textContent = \"\";\n      return;\n    }\n    var hits = index.filter(function (entry) {\n      var text = (entry.title + \" \" + entry.excerpt).toLowerCase();\n      return words.every(function (word) { return text.indexOf(word) !== -1; });\n    });\n    results.append.apply(results, hits.map(result));\n    status.textContent = hits.length === 1 ? \"1 result\" :\n      hits.length === 0 ? \"No results\" : hits.length + \" results\";\n  }\n\n  input.addEventListener(\"input\", show);\n  fetch(\"search-index.json\")\n    .then(function (response) {\n      if (!response.ok) { throw new Error(\"search index \" + response.status); }\n      return response.json();\n    })\n    .then(function (entries) { index = entries; show(); })\n    .catch(function () {\n      status.textContent = \"Search is unavailable: the search index didn't load.\";\n    });\n})();\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"6355a5e8-1d7c-44b4-b065-c0c66d237431","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"46a8d74b-d860-4909-a43f-d4dbcfcc3476","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"28e2330c-52aa-4363-b1f2-19829f0a52ed","version":"2.1.305","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"04bb0670-6a03-42e7-a607-c26c9220742b","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"e8d65e77-511b-45bf-91ac-78dd6b784096","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01GGiaYea8Jvci9ZiCABDGxm","type":"tool_result","content":"The file C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\app\\publish.py has been updated successfully."}]},"uuid":"ff919879-0180-4df0-8e8b-07489e5ba81f","timestamp":"2026-10-21T04:36:26.050Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\app\\publish.py","oldString":"# One stylesheet for the public site and the admin console (served at /style.css).\nCSS = Path(__file__).with_name(\"style.css\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n","newString":"# One stylesheet for the public site and the admin console (served at /style.css).\nCSS = Path(__file__).with_name(\"style.css\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n# search.html's one script, which searches site/search-index.json.\nSEARCH_JS = Path(__file__).with_name(\"search.js\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n","originalFile":"\"\"\"Render the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nT00 publishes a placeholder home page. As you build content types, extend\nrender_site() to write one file per published item. Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n     That includes links written in a body: render_markdown(..., to_root=...)\n     rewrites \"/contact-us.html\" and \"media/logo.png\" for the file it lands in.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import content as content_module\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.mdrender import render_markdown, render_text\n\n# One stylesheet for the public site and the admin console (served at /style.css).\nCSS = Path(__file__).with_name(\"style.css\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n# The most characters of a body that search.html shows under a result's title.\nEXCERPT_LENGTH = 160\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef nav_items(prefix: str = \"\") -> list[dict[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"Published Pages, as relative (title, href) links for the public\n    site's nav. `prefix` relocates the link for a page nested one\n    directory deep (e.g. \"../\" from site/posts/*.html) — a draft Page\n    never appears here.\"\"\"\n    return [{\"title\": page[\"title\"], \"href\": f\"{prefix}{page['slug']}.html\"}\n            for page in _exportable_pages()]\n\n\ndef _exportable_pages() -> list:\n    # The editor already refuses reserved slugs; this also covers rows saved\n    # before that check existed, so a Page can never overwrite site/index.html.\n    return [page for page in content_module.list_published(\"page\")\n            if not content_module.reserved_slug_reason(\"page\", page[\"slug\"])]\n\n\ndef _date(item) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The calendar day an item was created, e.g. \"2026-10-07\".\"\"\"\n    return item[\"created_at\"][:10]\n\n\ndef home_html() -> str:\n    \"\"\"The home page (feed of published Posts), as written to site/index.html.\"\"\"\n    posts = content_module.list_published(\"post\")\n    return environment().get_template(\"public/home.html\").render(\n        title=settings.SITE_TITLE, items=[\n            {\"title\": post[\"title\"], \"href\": f\"posts/{post['slug']}.html\",\n             \"date\": _date(post)} for post in posts\n        ],\n        css_path=\"style.css\", home_path=\"index.html\", nav_items=nav_items(),\n    )\n\n\ndef search_index_json() -> str:\n    \"\"\"site/search-index.json: the title, URL and a plain-text excerpt of\n    every published Post and Page, for search.html's script to search. Each\n    URL is relative to the site root, where search.html is.\"\"\"\n    entries = [(post, f\"posts/{post['slug']}.html\")\n               for post in content_module.list_published(\"post\")]\n    entries += [(page, f\"{page['slug']}.html\") for page in _exportable_pages()]\n    return json.dumps([\n        {\"title\": item[\"title\"], \"url\": url, \"excerpt\": _excerpt(item[\"body_md\"])}\n        for item, url in entries\n    ], ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)\n\n\ndef _excerpt(body_md: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The start of a body as plain text, cut at a word break to\n    EXCERPT_LENGTH characters or fewer, then \"…\" if anything was cut.\"\"\"\n    text = render_text(body_md)\n    if len(text) <= EXCERPT_LENGTH:\n        return text\n    return text[:EXCERPT_LENGTH + 1].rsplit(\" \", 1)[0][:EXCERPT_LENGTH] + \"…\"\n\n\ndef post_html(post) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A published Post, as written to site/posts/<slug>.html — one directory\n    deep, so every shared link climbs a level.\"\"\"\n    return _detail_html(\"public/post.html\", \"post\", post, prefix=\"../\")\n\n\ndef page_html(page) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A published Page, as written to site/<slug>.html.\"\"\"\n    return _detail_html(\"public/page.html\", \"page\", page, prefix=\"\")\n\n\ndef _detail_html(template_name: str, item_key: str, item, *, prefix: str) -> str:\n    return environment().get_template(template_name).render(\n        title=item[\"title\"], site_title=settings.SITE_TITLE,\n        **{item_key: item}, date=_date(item),\n        body_html=render_markdown(item[\"body_md\"], to_root=prefix),\n        css_path=f\"{prefix}style.css\", home_path=f\"{prefix}index.html\",\n        nav_items=nav_items(prefix=prefix),\n    )\n\n\ndef _write(path: Path, text: str) -> None:\n    # Explicit UTF-8: the pages declare <meta charset=\"utf-8\">, and the\n    # platform default (cp1252 on Windows) can't encode an emoji at all.\n    path.write_text(text, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    _write(out / \"style.css\", CSS)\n    _write(out / \"index.html\", home_html())\n\n    posts_dir = out / \"posts\"\n    posts_dir.mkdir()\n    for post in content_module.list_published(\"post\"):\n        _write(posts_dir / f\"{post['slug']}.html\", post_html(post))\n    for page in _exportable_pages():\n        _write(out / f\"{page['slug']}.html\", page_html(page))\n\n    # Every file in media/ is meant to be public; Posts show them through\n    # their Media library snippets.\n    if settings.MEDIA.is_dir():\n        shutil.copytree(settings.MEDIA, out / \"media\")\n\n    return out\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":23,"oldLines":6,"newStart":23,"newLines":8,"lines":[" "," # One stylesheet for the public site and the admin console (served at /style.css)."," CSS = Path(__file__).with_name(\"style.css\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")","+# search.html's one script, which searches site/search-index.json.","+SEARCH_JS = Path(__file__).with_name(\"search.js\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")"," "," # The most characters of a body that search.html shows under a result's title."," EXCERPT_LENGTH = 160"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"04bb0670-6a03-42e7-a607-c26c9220742b","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"46a8d74b-d860-4909-a43f-d4dbcfcc3476","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"28e2330c-52aa-4363-b1f2-19829f0a52ed","version":"2.1.305","gitBranch":"main"}

Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n     That includes links written in a body: render_markdown(..., to_root=...)\n     rewrites \"/contact-us.html\" and \"media/logo.png\" for the file it lands in.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import content as content_module\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.mdrender import render_markdown, render_text\n\n# One stylesheet for the public site and the admin console (served at /style.css).\nCSS = Path(__file__).with_name(\"style.css\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n# search.html's one script, which searches site/search-index.json.\nSEARCH_JS = Path(__file__).with_name(\"search.js\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n# The most characters of a body that search.html shows under a result's title.\nEXCERPT_LENGTH = 160\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef nav_items(prefix: str = \"\") -> list[dict[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"Published Pages, as relative (title, href) links for the public\n    site's nav. `prefix` relocates the link for a page nested one\n    directory deep (e.g. \"../\" from site/posts/*.html) — a draft Page\n    never appears here.\"\"\"\n    return [{\"title\": page[\"title\"], \"href\": f\"{prefix}{page['slug']}.html\"}\n            for page in _exportable_pages()]\n\n\ndef _exportable_pages() -> list:\n    # The editor already refuses reserved slugs; this also covers rows saved\n    # before that check existed, so a Page can never overwrite site/index.html.\n    return [page for page in content_module.list_published(\"page\")\n            if not content_module.reserved_slug_reason(\"page\", page[\"slug\"])]\n\n\ndef _date(item) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The calendar day an item was created, e.g. \"2026-10-07\".\"\"\"\n    return item[\"created_at\"][:10]\n\n\ndef home_html() -> str:\n    \"\"\"The home page (feed of published Posts), as written to site/index.html.\"\"\"\n    posts = content_module.list_published(\"post\")\n    return environment().get_template(\"public/home.html\").render(\n        title=settings.SITE_TITLE, items=[\n            {\"title\": post[\"title\"], \"href\": f\"posts/{post['slug']}.html\",\n             \"date\": _date(post)} for post in posts\n        ],\n        css_path=\"style.css\", home_path=\"index.html\", nav_items=nav_items(),\n    )\n\n\ndef search_index_json() -> str:\n    \"\"\"site/search-index.json: the title, URL and a plain-text excerpt of\n    every published Post and Page, for search.html's script to search. Each\n    URL is relative to the site root, where search.html is.\"\"\"\n    entries = [(post, f\"posts/{post['slug']}.html\")\n               for post in content_module.list_published(\"post\")]\n    entries += [(page, f\"{page['slug']}.html\") for page in _exportable_pages()]\n    return json.dumps([\n        {\"title\": item[\"title\"], \"url\": url, \"excerpt\": _excerpt(item[\"body_md\"])}\n        for item, url in entries\n    ], ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)\n\n\ndef _excerpt(body_md: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The start of a body as plain text, cut at a word break to\n    EXCERPT_LENGTH characters or fewer, then \"…\" if anything was cut.\"\"\"\n    text = render_text(body_md)\n    if len(text) <= EXCERPT_LENGTH:\n        return text\n    return text[:EXCERPT_LENGTH + 1].rsplit(\" \", 1)[0][:EXCERPT_LENGTH] + \"…\"\n\n\ndef post_html(post) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A published Post, as written to site/posts/<slug>.html — one directory\n    deep, so every shared link climbs a level.\"\"\"\n    return _detail_html(\"public/post.html\", \"post\", post, prefix=\"../\")\n\n\ndef page_html(page) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A published Page, as written to site/<slug>.html.\"\"\"\n    return _detail_html(\"public/page.html\", \"page\", page, prefix=\"\")\n\n\ndef _detail_html(template_name: str, item_key: str, item, *, prefix: str) -> str:\n    return environment().get_template(template_name).render(\n        title=item[\"title\"], site_title=settings.SITE_TITLE,\n        **{item_key: item}, date=_date(item),\n        body_html=render_markdown(item[\"body_md\"], to_root=prefix),\n        css_path=f\"{prefix}style.css\", home_path=f\"{prefix}index.html\",\n        nav_items=nav_items(prefix=prefix),\n    )\n\n\ndef _write(path: Path, text: str) -> None:\n    # Explicit UTF-8: the pages declare <meta charset=\"utf-8\">, and the\n    # platform default (cp1252 on Windows) can't encode an emoji at all.\n    path.write_text(text, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    _write(out / \"style.css\", CSS)\n    _write(out / \"index.html\", home_html())\n\n    posts_dir = out / \"posts\"\n    posts_dir.mkdir()\n    for post in content_module.list_published(\"post\"):\n        _write(posts_dir / f\"{post['slug']}.html\", post_html(post))\n    for page in _exportable_pages():\n        _write(out / f\"{page['slug']}.html\", page_html(page))\n\n    # Plain JavaScript, no library. Every URL is relative, because\n// GitHub Pages serves the site from a subfolder.\n(function () {\n  var input = document.getElementById(\"search-input\");\n  var status = document.getElementById(\"search-status\");\n  var results = document.getElementById(\"search-results\");\n  var index = null;\n\n  // Titles and excerpts are user content: build nodes with textContent,\n  // never innerHTML.\n  function result(entry) {\n    var link = document.createElement(\"a\");\n    link.className = \"post-card\";\n    link.href = entry.url;\n    var title = document.createElement(\"span\");\n    title.className = \"post-card__title\";\n    title.textContent = entry.title;\n    var excerpt = document.createElement(\"span\");\n    excerpt.className = \"post-card__excerpt\";\n    excerpt.textContent = entry.excerpt;\n    link.append(title, excerpt);\n    var item = document.createElement(\"li\");\n    item.append(link);\n    return item;\n  }\n\n  function show() {\n    var words = input.value.toLowerCase().split(/\\s+/).filter(Boolean);\n    results.replaceChildren();\n    if (index === null || words.length === 0) {\n      status.textContent = \"\";\n      return;\n    }\n    var hits = index.filter(function (entry) {\n      var text = (entry.title + \" \" + entry.excerpt).toLowerCase();\n      return words.every(function (word) { return text.indexOf(word) !== -1; });\n    });\n    results.append.apply(results, hits.map(result));\n    status.textContent = hits.length === 1 ? \"1 result\" :\n      hits.length === 0 ? \"No results\" : hits.length + \" results\";\n  }\n\n  input.addEventListener(\"input\", show);\n  fetch(\"search-index.json\")\n    .then(function (response) {\n      if (!response.ok) { throw new Error(\"search index \" + response.status); }\n      return response.json();\n    })\n    .then(function (entries) { index = entries; show(); })\n    .catch(function () {\n      status.textContent = \"Search is The dev server\nserves the same files at the same paths, through the same app.publish code,\nso these tests read them over HTTP. Each test is named after the acceptance\nstep on #22 it checks.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom html import unescape\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit\n\nfrom app import content as content_module\nfrom app import db as db_module\n\nBASE = \"http://testserver\"\n\n\ndef _admin_id() -> int:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'admin@example.test'\"\n        ).fetchone()[\"id\"]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef _seed(kind: str, title: str, slug: str, body_md: str, status: str = \"published\") -> int:\n    content_id = content_module.create_content(kind, title, slug, body_md, _admin_id())\n    if status == \"published\":\n        content_module.set_status(content_id, kind, \"published\")\n    return content_id\n\n\n# -- Step 1: the index has the title, relative URL and a short excerpt of each\n#    published Post and Page --\n\ndef test_step1_the_index_lists_each_published_post_and_page(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"robotics-kickoff\", \"Meet us in room 204.\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"About us\", \"about-us\", \"We promote computer science.\")\n\n    response = client.get(\"/search-index.json\")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"application/json\")\n    assert response.json() == [\n        {\"title\": \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"url\": \"posts/robotics-kickoff.html\",\n         \"excerpt\": \"Meet us in room 204.\"},\n        {\"title\": \"About us\", \"url\": \"about-us.html\",\n         \"excerpt\": \"We promote computer science.\"},\n    ]\n\n\ndef test_step1_the_excerpt_is_short_plain_text(client):\n    body = (\"# Welcome\\n\\nJoin **CS Honor Society** & meet [our officers](/about-us.html).\"\n            \"\\n\\n<script>alert(1)</script>\\n\\n\" + \"lorem \" * 80)\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Welcome\", \"welcome\", body)\n\n    excerpt = client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json()[0][\"excerpt\"]\n\n    assert excerpt.startswith(\"Welcome Join CS Honor Society & meet our officers. lorem lorem\")\n    assert \"<\" not in excerpt and \"alert\" not in excerpt and \"&amp;\" not in excerpt\n    assert len(excerpt) <= 161 and excerpt.endswith(\"lorem…\"), excerpt\n\n\n# -- Step 2: Drafts are absent from the index --\n\ndef test_step2_drafts_are_absent_from_the_index(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Live post\", \"live-post\", \"Public words.\")\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Secret draft post\", \"secret-post\", \"Hidden words.\", status=\"draft\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"Secret draft page\", \"secret-page\", \"Hidden words.\", status=\"draft\")\n    scheduled = _seed(\"post\", \"Secret scheduled post\", \"secret-scheduled\", \"Hidden words.\",\n                      status=\"draft\")\n    content_module.set_schedule(scheduled, \"post\", \"2099-01-01 00:00:00\")\n    unpublished = _seed(\"page\", \"Secret unpublished page\", \"secret-unpublished\", \"Hidden words.\")\n    content_module.set_status(unpublished, \"page\", \"draft\")\n\n    response = client.get(\"/search-index.json\")\n\n    assert [entry[\"title\"] for entry in response.json()] == [\"Live post\"]\n    assert \"secret\" not in response.text.lower() and \"hidden\" not in response.text.lower()\n\n\n# -- Step 3: search.html loads one plain JavaScript file of 60 lines or fewer,\n#    with no external dependency and relative paths only --\n\ndef _is_relative(url: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"True for a URL that resolves against the page it is on: no scheme,\n    no host, and no leading slash.\"\"\"\n    parts = urlsplit(url)\n    return not (parts.scheme or parts.netloc or url.startswith((\"/\", \"\\\\\")))\n\n\ndef _scripts(html: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(attributes, inline code) of every <script> element in `html`.\"\"\"\n    return re.findall(r\"<script\\b([^>]*)>(.*?)</script\\s*>\", html, re.S | re.I)\n\n\ndef test_step3_search_html_loads_one_local_script_of_at_most_60_lines(client):\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\")\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n\n    [(attributes, inline)] = _scripts(page.text)\n    assert inline.strip() == \"\"\n    src = unescape(re.search(r'\\bsrc=\"([^\"]*)\"', attributes).group(1))\n    assert _is_relative(src), src\n    script = client.get(urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/search.html\", src)).path)\n    assert script.status_code == 200\n    assert \"javascript\" in script.headers[\"content-type\"]\n    assert The dev server\nserves the same files at the same paths, through the same app.publish code,\nso these tests read them over HTTP. Each test is named after the acceptance\nstep on #22 it checks.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom html import unescape\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit\n\nfrom app import content as content_module\nfrom app import db as db_module\n\nBASE = \"http://testserver\"\n\n\ndef _admin_id() -> int:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'admin@example.test'\"\n        ).fetchone()[\"id\"]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef _seed(kind: str, title: str, slug: str, body_md: str, status: str = \"published\") -> int:\n    content_id = content_module.create_content(kind, title, slug, body_md, _admin_id())\n    if status == \"published\":\n        content_module.set_status(content_id, kind, \"published\")\n    return content_id\n\n\n# -- Step 1: the index has the title, relative URL and a short excerpt of each\n#    published Post and Page --\n\ndef test_step1_the_index_lists_each_published_post_and_page(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"robotics-kickoff\", \"Meet us in room 204.\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"About us\", \"about-us\", \"We promote computer science.\")\n\n    response = client.get(\"/search-index.json\")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"application/json\")\n    assert response.json() == [\n        {\"title\": \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"url\": \"posts/robotics-kickoff.html\",\n         \"excerpt\": \"Meet us in room 204.\"},\n        {\"title\": \"About us\", \"url\": \"about-us.html\",\n         \"excerpt\": \"We promote computer science.\"},\n    ]\n\n\ndef test_step1_the_excerpt_is_short_plain_text(client):\n    body = (\"# Welcome\\n\\nJoin **CS Honor Society** & meet [our officers](/about-us.html).\"\n            \"\\n\\n<script>alert(1)</script>\\n\\n\" + \"lorem \" * 80)\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Welcome\", \"welcome\", body)\n\n    excerpt = client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json()[0][\"excerpt\"]\n\n    assert excerpt.startswith(\"Welcome Join CS Honor Society & meet our officers. lorem lorem\")\n    assert \"<\" not in excerpt and \"alert\" not in excerpt and \"&amp;\" not in excerpt\n    assert len(excerpt) <= 161 and excerpt.endswith(\"lorem…\"), excerpt\n\n\n# -- Step 2: Drafts are absent from the index --\n\ndef test_step2_drafts_are_absent_from_the_index(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Live post\", \"live-post\", \"Public words.\")\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Secret draft post\", \"secret-post\", \"Hidden words.\", status=\"draft\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"Secret draft page\", \"secret-page\", \"Hidden words.\", status=\"draft\")\n    scheduled = _seed(\"post\", \"Secret scheduled post\", \"secret-scheduled\", \"Hidden words.\",\n                      status=\"draft\")\n    content_module.set_schedule(scheduled, \"post\", \"2099-01-01 00:00:00\")\n    unpublished = _seed(\"page\", \"Secret unpublished page\", \"secret-unpublished\", \"Hidden words.\")\n    content_module.set_status(unpublished, \"page\", \"draft\")\n\n    response = client.get(\"/search-index.json\")\n\n    assert [entry[\"title\"] for entry in response.json()] == [\"Live post\"]\n    assert \"secret\" not in response.text.lower() and \"hidden\" not in response.text.lower()\n\n\n# -- Step 3: search.html loads one plain JavaScript file of 60 lines or fewer,\n#    with no external dependency and relative paths only --\n\ndef _is_relative(url: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"True for a URL that resolves against the page it is on: no scheme,\n    no host, and no leading slash.\"\"\"\n    parts = urlsplit(url)\n    return not (parts.scheme or parts.netloc or url.startswith((\"/\", \"\\\\\")))\n\n\ndef _scripts(html: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(attributes, inline code) of every <script> element in `html`.\"\"\"\n    return re.findall(r\"<script\\b([^>]*)>(.*?)</script\\s*>\", html, re.S | re.I)\n\n\ndef test_step3_search_html_loads_one_local_script_of_at_most_60_lines(client):\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\")\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n\n    [(attributes, inline)] = _scripts(page.text)\n    assert inline.strip() == \"\"\n    src = unescape(re.search(r'\\bsrc=\"([^\"]*)\"', attributes).group(1))\n    assert _is_relative(src), src\n    script = client.get(urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/search.html\", src)).path)\n    assert script.status_code == 200\n    assert \"javascript\" in script.headers[\"content-type\"]\n    assert len(script.text.splitlines()) <= 60\n\n\ndef test_step3_search_html_and_its_script_use_only_relative_urls(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"robotics-kickoff\", \"Meet us in The dev server\nserves the same files at the same paths, through the same app.publish code,\nso these tests read them over HTTP. Each test is named after the acceptance\nstep on #22 it checks.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom html import unescape\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit\n\nfrom app import content as content_module\nfrom app import db as db_module\nfrom tests.conftest import extract_csrf\n\nBASE = \"http://testserver\"\n\n\ndef _admin_id() -> int:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'admin@example.test'\"\n        ).fetchone()[\"id\"]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef _seed(kind: str, title: str, slug: str, body_md: str, status: str = \"published\") -> int:\n    content_id = content_module.create_content(kind, title, slug, body_md, _admin_id())\n    if status == \"published\":\n        content_module.set_status(content_id, kind, \"published\")\n    return content_id\n\n\n# -- Step 1: the index has the title, relative URL and a short excerpt of each\n#    published Post and Page --\n\ndef test_step1_the_index_lists_each_published_post_and_page(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"robotics-kickoff\", \"Meet us in room 204.\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"About us\", \"about-us\", \"We promote computer science.\")\n\n    response = client.get(\"/search-index.json\")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"application/json\")\n    assert response.json() == [\n        {\"title\": \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"url\": \"posts/robotics-kickoff.html\",\n         \"excerpt\": \"Meet us in room 204.\"},\n        {\"title\": \"About us\", \"url\": \"about-us.html\",\n         \"excerpt\": \"We promote computer science.\"},\n    ]\n\n\ndef test_step1_the_excerpt_is_short_plain_text(client):\n    body = (\"# Welcome\\n\\nJoin **CS Honor Society** & meet [our officers](/about-us.html).\"\n            \"\\n\\n<script>alert(1)</script>\\n\\n\" + \"lorem \" * 80)\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Welcome\", \"welcome\", body)\n\n    excerpt = client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json()[0][\"excerpt\"]\n\n    assert excerpt.startswith(\"Welcome Join CS Honor Society & meet our officers. lorem lorem\")\n    assert \"<\" not in excerpt and \"alert\" not in excerpt and \"&amp;\" not in excerpt\n    assert len(excerpt) <= 161 and excerpt.endswith(\"lorem…\"), excerpt\n\n\n# -- Step 2: Drafts are absent from the index --\n\ndef test_step2_drafts_are_absent_from_the_index(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Live post\", \"live-post\", \"Public words.\")\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Secret draft post\", \"secret-post\", \"Hidden words.\", status=\"draft\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"Secret draft page\", \"secret-page\", \"Hidden words.\", status=\"draft\")\n    scheduled = _seed(\"post\", \"Secret scheduled post\", \"secret-scheduled\", \"Hidden words.\",\n                      status=\"draft\")\n    content_module.set_schedule(scheduled, \"post\", \"2099-01-01 00:00:00\")\n    unpublished = _seed(\"page\", \"Secret unpublished page\", \"secret-unpublished\", \"Hidden words.\")\n    content_module.set_status(unpublished, \"page\", \"draft\")\n\n    response = client.get(\"/search-index.json\")\n\n    assert [entry[\"title\"] for entry in response.json()] == [\"Live post\"]\n    assert \"secret\" not in response.text.lower() and \"hidden\" not in response.text.lower()\n\n\n# -- Step 3: search.html loads one plain JavaScript file of 60 lines or fewer,\n#    with no external dependency and relative paths only --\n\ndef _is_relative(url: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"True for a URL that resolves against the page it is on: no scheme,\n    no host, and no leading slash.\"\"\"\n    parts = urlsplit(url)\n    return not (parts.scheme or parts.netloc or url.startswith((\"/\", \"\\\\\")))\n\n\ndef _scripts(html: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(attributes, inline code) of every <script> element in `html`.\"\"\"\n    return re.findall(r\"<script\\b([^>]*)>(.*?)</script\\s*>\", html, re.S | re.I)\n\n\ndef test_step3_search_html_loads_one_local_script_of_at_most_60_lines(client):\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\")\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n\n    [(attributes, inline)] = _scripts(page.text)\n    assert inline.strip() == \"\"\n    src = unescape(re.search(r'\\bsrc=\"([^\"]*)\"', attributes).group(1))\n    assert _is_relative(src), src\n    script = client.get(urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/search.html\", src)).path)\n    assert script.status_code == 200\n    assert \"javascript\" in script.headers[\"content-type\"]\n    assert len(script.text.splitlines()) <= 60\n\n\ndef test_step3_search_html_and_its_script_use_only_relative_urls(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"robotics-kickoff\", \"Meet us in room 204.\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"About us\", \"about-us\", \"We promote computer science.\")\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\").text\n\n    urls = [unescape(url) for url in re.findall(r'\\b(?:href|src)=\"([^\"]*)\"', page)]\n    assert urls and all(_is_relative(url) for url in urls), urls\n    [(attributes, _)] = _scripts(page)\n    src = unescape(re.search(r'\\bsrc=\"([^\"]*)\"', attributes).group(1))\n    script = client.get(urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/search.html\", src)).path).text\n    # No library pulled in, and no string the script could fetch from the root\n    # or another host (\"/search-index.json\" fails on a Pages subfolder).\n    assert not re.search(r\"\\b(import|require)\\s*\\(|\\bimport\\s\", script)\n    assert \"://\" not in script\n    assert not re.search(r\"\"\"[\"'`]/\"\"\", script), \"a string in the script starts with /\"\n    assert all(_is_relative(entry[\"url\"]) for entry in client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json())\n\n\ndef test_step3_a_page_cannot_take_the_search_slug(client_as):\n    # A Page is exported to site/<slug>.html, so slug \"search\" would\n    # overwrite the search page.\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = editor.post(\"/admin/pages/new\", data={\n        \"title\": \"Search\", \"slug\": \"search\", \"body_md\": \"x\",\n        \"csrf_token\": extract_csrf(editor.get(\"/admin/pages/new\").text),\n    })\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"reserved\" in response.text.lower()\n    assert (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"210a3751-fd4e-4be1-b858-76f29951e2f8","timestamp":"2026-10-21T04:37:24.804Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\tests\\test_search.py","oldString":"    assert \"Old search page\" not in page and len(_scripts(page)) == 1\n    assert client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json() == []\n","newString":"    assert \"Old search page\" not in page and len(_scripts(page)) == 1\n    assert client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json() == []\n\n\n# -- Step 5: the published home page links to search.html with a relative path --\n\ndef test_step5_the_home_page_links_to_search_html_with_a_relative_path(client):\n    home = client.get(\"/index.html\").text\n\n    hrefs = [unescape(href) for href in re.findall(r'<a\\b[^>]*\\bhref=\"([^\"]*)\"', home)]\n    search_links = [href for href in hrefs\n                    if urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/index.html\", href)).path == \"/search.html\"]\n    assert search_links, hrefs\n    assert all(_is_relative(href) for href in search_links), search_links\n    assert client.get(\"/search.html\").status_code == 200\n","originalFile":"\"\"\"MP2plus F5: site search (issue #22).\n\n`cms publish` writes search-index.json (the title, relative URL and a short\nexcerpt of each published Post and Page) and search.html, which searches it\nwith one short script; the home page links to search.html. The dev server\nserves the same files at the same paths, through the same app.publish code,\nso these tests read them over HTTP. Each test is named after the acceptance\nstep on #22 it checks.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom html import unescape\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit\n\nfrom app import content as content_module\nfrom app import db as db_module\nfrom tests.conftest import extract_csrf\n\nBASE = \"http://testserver\"\n\n\ndef _admin_id() -> int:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'admin@example.test'\"\n        ).fetchone()[\"id\"]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef _seed(kind: str, title: str, slug: str, body_md: str, status: str = \"published\") -> int:\n    content_id = content_module.create_content(kind, title, slug, body_md, _admin_id())\n    if status == \"published\":\n        content_module.set_status(content_id, kind, \"published\")\n    return content_id\n\n\n# -- Step 1: the index has the title, relative URL and a short excerpt of each\n#    published Post and Page --\n\ndef test_step1_the_index_lists_each_published_post_and_page(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"robotics-kickoff\", \"Meet us in room 204.\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"About us\", \"about-us\", \"We promote computer science.\")\n\n    response = client.get(\"/search-index.json\")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"application/json\")\n    assert response.json() == [\n        {\"title\": \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"url\": \"posts/robotics-kickoff.html\",\n         \"excerpt\": \"Meet us in room 204.\"},\n        {\"title\": \"About us\", \"url\": \"about-us.html\",\n         \"excerpt\": \"We promote computer science.\"},\n    ]\n\n\ndef test_step1_the_excerpt_is_short_plain_text(client):\n    body = (\"# Welcome\\n\\nJoin **CS Honor Society** & meet [our officers](/about-us.html).\"\n            \"\\n\\n<script>alert(1)</script>\\n\\n\" + \"lorem \" * 80)\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Welcome\", \"welcome\", body)\n\n    excerpt = client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json()[0][\"excerpt\"]\n\n    assert excerpt.startswith(\"Welcome Join CS Honor Society & meet our officers. lorem lorem\")\n    assert \"<\" not in excerpt and \"alert\" not in excerpt and \"&amp;\" not in excerpt\n    assert len(excerpt) <= 161 and excerpt.endswith(\"lorem…\"), excerpt\n\n\n# -- Step 2: Drafts are absent from the index --\n\ndef test_step2_drafts_are_absent_from_the_index(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Live post\", \"live-post\", \"Public words.\")\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Secret draft post\", \"secret-post\", \"Hidden words.\", status=\"draft\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"Secret draft page\", \"secret-page\", \"Hidden words.\", status=\"draft\")\n    scheduled = _seed(\"post\", \"Secret scheduled post\", \"secret-scheduled\", \"Hidden words.\",\n                      status=\"draft\")\n    content_module.set_schedule(scheduled, \"post\", \"2099-01-01 00:00:00\")\n    unpublished = _seed(\"page\", \"Secret unpublished page\", \"secret-unpublished\", \"Hidden words.\")\n    content_module.set_status(unpublished, \"page\", \"draft\")\n\n    response = client.get(\"/search-index.json\")\n\n    assert [entry[\"title\"] for entry in response.json()] == [\"Live post\"]\n    assert \"secret\" not in response.text.lower() and \"hidden\" not in response.text.lower()\n\n\n# -- Step 3: search.html loads one plain JavaScript file of 60 lines or fewer,\n#    with no external dependency and relative paths only --\n\ndef _is_relative(url: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"True for a URL that resolves against the page it is on: no scheme,\n    no host, and no leading slash.\"\"\"\n    parts = urlsplit(url)\n    return not (parts.scheme or parts.netloc or url.startswith((\"/\", \"\\\\\")))\n\n\ndef _scripts(html: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(attributes, inline code) of every <script> element in `html`.\"\"\"\n    return re.findall(r\"<script\\b([^>]*)>(.*?)</script\\s*>\", html, re.S | re.I)\n\n\ndef test_step3_search_html_loads_one_local_script_of_at_most_60_lines(client):\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\")\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n\n    [(attributes, inline)] = _scripts(page.text)\n    assert inline.strip() == \"\"\n    src = unescape(re.search(r'\\bsrc=\"([^\"]*)\"', attributes).group(1))\n    assert _is_relative(src), src\n    script = client.get(urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/search.html\", src)).path)\n    assert script.status_code == 200\n    assert \"javascript\" in script.headers[\"content-type\"]\n    assert len(script.text.splitlines()) <= 60\n\n\ndef test_step3_search_html_and_its_script_use_only_relative_urls(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"robotics-kickoff\", \"Meet us in room 204.\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"About us\", \"about-us\", \"We promote computer science.\")\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\").text\n\n    urls = [unescape(url) for url in re.findall(r'\\b(?:href|src)=\"([^\"]*)\"', page)]\n    assert urls and all(_is_relative(url) for url in urls), urls\n    [(attributes, _)] = _scripts(page)\n    src = unescape(re.search(r'\\bsrc=\"([^\"]*)\"', attributes).group(1))\n    script = client.get(urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/search.html\", src)).path).text\n    # No library pulled in, and no string the script could fetch from the root\n    # or another host (\"/search-index.json\" fails on a Pages subfolder).\n    assert not re.search(r\"\\b(import|require)\\s*\\(|\\bimport\\s\", script)\n    assert \"://\" not in script\n    assert not re.search(r\"\"\"[\"'`]/\"\"\", script), \"a string in the script starts with /\"\n    assert all(_is_relative(entry[\"url\"]) for entry in client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json())\n\n\ndef test_step3_a_page_cannot_take_the_search_slug(client_as):\n    # A Page is exported to site/<slug>.html, so slug \"search\" would\n    # overwrite the search page.\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = editor.post(\"/admin/pages/new\", data={\n        \"title\": \"Search\", \"slug\": \"search\", \"body_md\": \"x\",\n        \"csrf_token\": extract_csrf(editor.get(\"/admin/pages/new\").text),\n    })\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"reserved\" in response.text.lower()\n    assert content_module.list_content(\"page\") == []\n\n\ndef test_step3_a_page_saved_with_the_search_slug_before_it_was_reserved_is_left_out(client):\n    _seed(\"page\", \"Old search page\", \"search\", \"Saved before the slug was reserved.\")\n\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\").text\n\n    assert \"Old search page\" not in page and len(_scripts(page)) == 1\n    assert client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json() == []\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":154,"oldLines":3,"newStart":154,"newLines":16,"lines":[" ","     assert \"Old search page\" not in page and noqa: E402\n\nif WORK.exists():\n    shutil.rmtree(WORK)\nWORK.mkdir(parents=True)\nsettings.DATABASE_PATH = WORK / \"cms.db\"\nsettings.MEDIA = WORK / \"media\"\nsettings.SITE = WORK / \"site\"\n\nimport uvicorn  # noqa: E402\nfrom playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright  # noqa: E402\n\nfrom app import cli  # noqa: E402\nfrom app import content as content_module  # noqa: E402\nfrom app import db as db_module  # noqa: E402\nfrom app.main import create_app  # noqa: E402\nfrom app.seed import seed_pages, seed_posts, seed_users  # noqa: E402\n\nseed_users(settings.DATABASE_PATH, \"walk-admin-pw\", \"walk-editor-pw\")\nseed_posts(settings.DATABASE_PATH)\nseed_pages(settings.DATABASE_PATH)\nconn = db_module.connect()\nADMIN = conn.execute(\"SELECT id FROM users WHERE role = 'admin'\").fetchone()[\"id\"]\nconn.close()\n\n\ndef add(kind, title, slug, body, published=True):\n    content_id = content_module.create_content(kind, title, slug, body, ADMIN)\n    if published:\n        content_module.set_status(content_id, kind, \"published\")\n\n\nadd(\"post\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"robotics-kickoff\",\n    \"Our first **robotics** meeting is Thursday in room 204. Bring a laptop & \"\n    \"[read the rules](/about.html) first.\\n\\n\" + \"We will build line-following robots. \" * 12)\nadd(\"post\", \"Hour of Code volunteers needed\", \"hour-of-code\",\n    \"Help us teach younger students to code during <em>Computer Science</em> Education Week.\")\nadd(\"post\", \"Secret officer elections draft\", \"officer-elections\",\n    \"Not ready yet: robotics budget talk.\", published=False)\nadd(\"page\", \"Secret coursework draft\", \"coursework\", \"Draft page body.\", published=False)\n\nresults = []\n\n\ndef check(name, ok, detail=\"\"):\n    results.append((name, bool(ok)))\n    print((\"PASS \" if ok else \"FAIL \") + name + (f\"  ({detail})\" if detail and not ok else \"\"))\n\n\ndef free_port():\n    s = socket.socket()\n    s.bind((\"127.0.0.1\", 0))\n    port = s.getsockname()[1]\n    s.close()\n    return port\n\n\ndef overflow(page):\n    return page.evaluate(\"document.documentElement.scrollWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth\")\n\n\n# -- Steps 1-3 and 5: publish with drafts present, read site/ --\ncheck(\"cms publish exits 0\", cli.main([\"publish\"]) == 0)\nsite = settings.SITE\nindex = json.loads((site / \"search-index.json\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\nprint(json.dumps(index, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False))\ntitles = [entry[\"title\"] for entry in index]\ncheck(\"1 index has every published post and page\",\n      sorted(titles) == sorted([\"Welcome\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"Hour of Code volunteers needed\", \"About\"]), titles)\ncheck(\"1 each entry has title, url, excerpt\", all(set(e) == {\"title\", \"url\", \"excerpt\"} for e in index))\ncheck(\"1 urls are relative and exist\",\n      all(not e[\"url\"].startswith(\"/\") and \":\" not in e[\"url\"] and (site / e[\"url\"]).is_file() for e in index))\ncheck(\"1 excerpts are short plain text\", all(len(e[\"excerpt\"]) <= 161 and \"<\" not in e[\"excerpt\"] for e in index))\nraw_index = (site / \"search-index.json\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\ncheck(\"2 drafts absent\", \"Secret\" not in raw_index and \"Upcoming\" not in raw_index and \"Not ready\" not in raw_index)\nsearch_page = (site / \"search.html\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\nscripts = re.findall(r\"<script\\b([^>]*)>(.*?)</script>\", search_page, re.S)\ncheck(\"3 one script tag, external file, relative src\",\n      len(scripts) == 1 and scripts[0][1].strip() == \"\" and 'src=\"search.js\"' in scripts[0][0], scripts)\njs = (site / \"search.js\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\ncheck(\"3 search.js is 60 lines or fewer\", len(js.splitlines()) <= 60, len(js.splitlines()))\ncheck(\"3 no external URL in search.js\", \"://\" not in js and \"import\" not in js)\ncheck(\"3 no root-absolute href/src in search.html\", 'href=\"/' not in search_page and 'src=\"/' not in search_page)\nhome = (site / \"index.html\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\ncheck(\"5 home links to search.html relatively\", 'href=\"search.html\"' in home)\nall_html = \"\\n\".join(p.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\") for p in site.rglob(\"*.html\"))\ncheck(\"no root-absolute href/src anywhere in site/\", 'href=\"/' not in all_html and 'src=\"/' not in all_html)\n\n# -- Step 4: preview with python -m http.server, as the judge does --\nSCREENSHOTS = REPO / \"docs\" / \"screenshots\"\nsite_port = free_port()\nhttp = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, \"-m\", \"http.server\", \"-d\", str(site), str(site_port)],\n                        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)\n\nsock = socket.socket()\nsock.bind((\"127.0.0.1\", 0))\ndev_port = sock.getsockname()[1]\nserver = uvicorn.Server(uvicorn.Config(create_app(), log_level=\"warning\"))\nthreading.Thread(target=server.run, kwargs={\"sockets\": [sock]}, daemon=True).start()\nwhile not server.started:\n    time.sleep(0.05)\n\n\ndef walk(browser, base, width, label, shot=None):\n    context = browser.new_context(viewport={\"width\": width, \"height\": 900 if width > 400 else 844})\n    page = context.new_page()\n    errors = []\n    page.on(\"console\", lambda m: errors.append(m.text) if m.type == \"error\" else None)\n    page.on(\"pageerror\", lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))\n    page.goto(base + \"/index.html\")\n    page.click(\"a[href='search.html']\")\n    page.wait_for_url(\"**/search.html\")\n    check(f\"{label} search page fits\", overflow(page) <= 0, overflow(page))\n    page.fill(\"#search-input\", \"Robotics\")\n    page.wait_for_selector(\"#search-results a\", timeout=5000)\n    links = page.locator(\"#search-results a\")\n    check(f\"{label} 4 one result for 'Robotics'\", links.count() == 1, links.count())\n page.inner_text(\"#search-status\") == \"1 result\")\n    check(f\"{label} result page fits\", overflow(page) <= 0, overflow(page))\n    if shot:\n        page.screenshot(path=str(shot), full_page=True)\n    links.first.click()\n    page.wait_for_url(\"**/posts/robotics-kickoff.html\")\n    check(f\"{label} 4 link opens the post\", page.inner_text(\"h1\") == \"Robotics club kickoff\")\n    page.go_back()\n    page.wait_for_url(\"**/search.html\")\n    page.fill(\"#search-input\", \"zzqx\")\n    page.wait_for_function(\"document.getElementById('search-status').textContent === 'No results'\")\n    check(f\"{label} no-results message\", page.locator(\"#search-results li\").count() == 0)\n    page.fill(\"#search-input\", \"secret\")\n    page.wait_for_function(\"document.getElementById('search-status').textContent === 'No results'\")\n    check(f\"{label} a draft's title finds nothing\", page.locator(\"#search-results li\").count() == 0)\n    page.fill(\"#search-input\", \"code volunteers\")\n    page.wait_for_function(\"document.getElementById('search-status').textContent === '1 result'\")\n    check(f\"{label} two words, both must match\", page.inner_text(\"#search-results .post-card__title\")\n          == \"Hour of Code volunteers needed\")\n    check(f\"{label} no console errors\", not errors, errors)\n    context.close()\n\n\ntry:\n    time.sleep(1.0)\n    with sync_playwright() as pw:\n        browser = pw.chromium.launch()\n        site_base = f\"http://127.0.0.1:{site_port}\"\n        walk(browser, site_base, 1280, \"site@1280\", SCREENSHOTS / \"mp2plus-search-1280.png\" if SHOTS else None)\n        walk(browser, site_base, 390, \"site@390\", SCREENSHOTS / \"mp2plus-search-390.png\" if SHOTS else None)\n        walk(browser, f\"http://127.0.0.1:{dev_port}\", 1280, \"dev@1280\")\n\n        # Opened straight from disk, the fetch is blocked: the page says so.\n        page = browser.new_page()\n        page.goto((site / \"search.html\").as_uri())\n        page.wait_for_function(\"document.getElementById('search-status').textContent !== ''\", timeout=5000)\n        check(\"file:// shows the unavailable message\", \"unavailable\" in page.inner_text(\"#search-status\"))\n        browser.close()\nfinally:\n    http.terminate()\n    server.should_exit = Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n     That includes links written in a body: render_markdown(..., to_root=...)\n     rewrites \"/contact-us.html\" and \"media/logo.png\" for the file it lands in.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import content as content_module\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.mdrender import render_markdown, render_text\n\n# One stylesheet for the public site and the admin console (served at /style.css).\nCSS = Path(__file__).with_name(\"style.css\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n# search.html's one script, which searches site/search-index.json.\nSEARCH_JS = Path(__file__).with_name(\"search.js\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n# The most characters of a body that search.html shows under a result's title.\nEXCERPT_LENGTH = 160\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef nav_items(prefix: str = \"\") -> list[dict[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"Published Pages, as relative (title, href) links for the public\n    site's nav. `prefix` relocates the link for a page nested one\n    directory deep (e.g. \"../\" from site/posts/*.html) — a draft Page\n    never appears here.\"\"\"\n    return [{\"title\": page[\"title\"], \"href\": f\"{prefix}{page['slug']}.html\"}\n            for page in _exportable_pages()]\n\n\ndef _exportable_pages() -> list:\n    # The editor already refuses reserved slugs; this also covers rows saved\n    # before that check existed, so a Page can never overwrite site/index.html.\n    return [page for page in content_module.list_published(\"page\")\n            if not content_module.reserved_slug_reason(\"page\", page[\"slug\"])]\n\n\ndef _date(item) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The calendar day an item was created, e.g. \"2026-10-07\".\"\"\"\n    return item[\"created_at\"][:10]\n\n\ndef home_html() -> str:\n    \"\"\"The home page (feed of published Posts), as written to site/index.html.\"\"\"\n    posts = content_module.list_published(\"post\")\n    return environment().get_template(\"public/home.html\").render(\n        title=settings.SITE_TITLE, items=[\n            {\"title\": post[\"title\"], \"href\": f\"posts/{post['slug']}.html\",\n             \"date\": _date(post)} for post in posts\n        ],\n        css_path=\"style.css\", home_path=\"index.html\", nav_items=nav_items(),\n    )\n\n\ndef search_html() -> str:\n    \"\"\"The search page, as written to site/search.html; its script is\n    site/search.js.\"\"\"\n    return environment().get_template(\"public/search.html\").render(\n        title=\"Search\", site_title=settings.SITE_TITLE,\n        css_path=\"style.css\", home_path=\"index.html\", nav_items=nav_items(),\n    )\n\n\ndef search_index_json() -> str:\n    \"\"\"site/search-index.json: the title, URL and a plain-text excerpt of\n    every published Post and Page, for search.html's script to search. Each\n    URL is relative to the site root, where search.html is.\"\"\"\n    entries = [(post, f\"posts/{post['slug']}.html\")\n               for post in content_module.list_published(\"post\")]\n    entries += [(page, f\"{page['slug']}.html\") for page in _exportable_pages()]\n    return json.dumps([\n        {\"title\": item[\"title\"], \"url\": url, \"excerpt\": _excerpt(item[\"body_md\"])}\n        for item, url in entries\n    ], ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)\n\n\ndef _excerpt(body_md: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The start of a body as plain text, cut at a word break to\n    EXCERPT_LENGTH characters or fewer, then \"…\" if anything was cut.\"\"\"\n    text = render_text(body_md)\n    if len(text) <= EXCERPT_LENGTH:\n        return text\n    return text[:EXCERPT_LENGTH + 1].rsplit(\" \", 1)[0][:EXCERPT_LENGTH] + \"…\"\n\n\ndef post_html(post) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A published Post, as written to site/posts/<slug>.html — one directory\n    deep, so every shared link climbs a level.\"\"\"\n    return _detail_html(\"public/post.html\", \"post\", post, prefix=\"../\")\n\n\ndef page_html(page) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A published Page, as written to site/<slug>.html.\"\"\"\n    return _detail_html(\"public/page.html\", \"page\", page, prefix=\"\")\n\n\ndef _detail_html(template_name: str, item_key: str, item, *, prefix: str) -> str:\n    return environment().get_template(template_name).render(\n        title=item[\"title\"], site_title=settings.SITE_TITLE,\n        **{item_key: item}, date=_date(item),\n        body_html=render_markdown(item[\"body_md\"], to_root=prefix),\n        css_path=f\"{prefix}style.css\", home_path=f\"{prefix}index.html\",\n        nav_items=nav_items(prefix=prefix),\n    )\n\n\ndef _write(path: Path, text: str) -> None:\n    # Explicit UTF-8: the pages declare <meta charset=\"utf-8\">, and the\n    # platform default (cp1252 on Windows) can't encode an emoji at all.\n    path.write_text(text, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    _write(out / \"style.css\", CSS)\n    _write(out / \"index.html\", home_html())\n    _write(out / \"search.html\", search_html())\n    _write(out / \"search.js\", SEARCH_JS)\n    _write(out / \"search-index.json\", search_index_json())\n\n    posts_dir = out / \"posts\"\n    posts_dir.mkdir()\n    for post in content_module.list_published(\"post\"):\n        _write(posts_dir / f\"{post['slug']}.html\", post_html(post))\n    for page in _exportable_pages():\n        _write(out / f\"{page['slug']}.html\", page_html(page))\n\n    # Every file in media/ is meant to be public; Posts show them through\n    # their Media library snippets.\n    if settings.MEDIA.is_dir():\n        shutil.copytree(settings.MEDIA, out / \"media\")\n\n    return out\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":98,"oldLines":7,"newStart":98,"newLines":7,"lines":["     text = render_text(body_md)","     if len(text) <= EXCERPT_LENGTH:","         return text","-    return text[:EXCERPT_LENGTH + 1].rsplit(\" \", 1)[0][:EXCERPT_LENGTH] + \"…\"","+    return text[:EXCERPT_LENGTH + 1].rsplit(\" \", 1)[0][:EXCERPT_LENGTH].rstrip(\" .,;:\") + \"…\""," "," "," def post_html(post) -> str:"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"ca24654b-818e-45e7-9464-c8ed269a5bdf","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"46a8d74b-d860-4909-a43f-d4dbcfcc3476","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"28e2330c-52aa-4363-b1f2-19829f0a52ed","version":"2.1.305","gitBranch":"main"}

{"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"28e2330c-52aa-4363-b1f2-19829f0a52ed","hash":"d54801f718f3b3a7eee2c12db92b607fc3a3f1a8f62a1b10c451eb900af6a25d","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":"toolu_016wcBQ7MKZFHzRngep5zNfG","content":"Launching skill: mattpocock-skills:code-review"},{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: C:\\Users\\rajan\\.claude\\plugins\\cache\\claude-plugins-official\\mattpocock-skills\\1.3.1\\skills\\engineering\\code-review\n\nTwo-axis review of the diff between `HEAD` and a fixed point the user supplies:\r\n\r\n- **Standards**: does the code conform to this repo's documented coding standards?\r\n- **Spec**: does the code faithfully implement the originating issue / spec?\r\n\r\nBoth axes run as **parallel sub-agents** so they don't pollute each other's context, then this skill aggregates their findings.\r\n\r\nThe issue tracker should have been provided to you. If not, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.\r\n\r\n## Process\r\n\r\n### 1. Pin the fixed point\r\n\r\nWhatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.\r\n\r\nCapture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.\r\n\r\nBefore going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.\r\n\r\n### 2. Identify the spec source\r\n\r\nLook for the originating spec, in this order:\r\n\r\n1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in the tracker doc.\r\n2. A path the user passed as an argument.\r\n3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.\r\n4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report \"no spec available\".\r\n\r\n### 3. Identify the standards sources\r\n\r\nSearch the repo for every file that documents how code should be written. When `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md` exists, it must be on the list.\r\n\r\nOn top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:\r\n\r\n- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.\r\n- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic (\"possible Feature Envy\"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.\r\n\r\nEach smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:\r\n\r\n- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.\r\n- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.\r\n- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.\r\n- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.\r\n- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.\r\n- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.\r\n- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.\r\n- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.\r\n- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.\r\n- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.\r\n- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.\r\n- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.\r\n\r\n### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel\r\n\r\nIssue both sub-agent calls together, in the foreground, and aggregate the reports they return.\r\n\r\n**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:\r\n\r\n- The full diff command and commit list.\r\n- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).\r\n- The brief: \"Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words.\"\r\n\r\n**Spec sub-agent prompt** should include:\r\n\r\n- The diff command and commit list.\r\n- The path or fetched contents of the spec.\r\n- The brief: \"Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words.\"\r\n\r\nIf the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.\r\n\r\n### 5. Aggregate\r\n\r\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).\r\n\r\nEnd with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\r\n\r\n## Why two axes\r\n\r\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\r\n\r\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\r\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\r\n\r\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\r\n\n\nARGUMENTS: Review the uncommitted working-tree changes since HEAD (5cf2937) for issue #22 (MP2plus F5: Site search). Exclude notes/usage-ledger.csv and docs/transcripts/ (the user's files). New untracked files: app/search.js, templates/public/search.html, tests/test_search.py."}]}}

{"parentUuid":"353941c3-e05f-4f84-8c4d-7c36a804ebd1","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"92776e4d-bddb-481c-9fbe-fa85b9ee9733","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: C:\\Users\\rajan\\.claude\\plugins\\cache\\claude-plugins-official\\mattpocock-skills\\1.3.1\\skills\\engineering\\code-review\n\nTwo-axis review of the diff between `HEAD` and a fixed point the user supplies:\r\n\r\n- **Standards**: does the code conform to this repo's documented coding standards?\r\n- **Spec**: does the code faithfully implement the originating issue / spec?\r\n\r\nBoth axes run as **parallel sub-agents** so they don't pollute each other's context, then this skill aggregates their findings.\r\n\r\nThe issue tracker should have been provided to you. If not, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.\r\n\r\n## Process\r\n\r\n### 1. Pin the fixed point\r\n\r\nWhatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.\r\n\r\nCapture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.\r\n\r\nBefore going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.\r\n\r\n### 2. Identify the spec source\r\n\r\nLook for the originating spec, in this order:\r\n\r\n1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in the tracker doc.\r\n2. A path the user passed as an argument.\r\n3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.\r\n4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report \"no spec available\".\r\n\r\n### 3. Identify the standards sources\r\n\r\nSearch the repo for every file that documents how code should be written. When `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md` exists, it must be on the list.\r\n\r\nOn top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:\r\n\r\n- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.\r\n- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic (\"possible Feature Envy\"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.\r\n\r\nEach smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:\r\n\r\n- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.\r\n- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.\r\n- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.\r\n- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.\r\n- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.\r\n- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.\r\n- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.\r\n- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.\r\n- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.\r\n- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.\r\n- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.\r\n- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.\r\n\r\n### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel\r\n\r\nIssue both sub-agent calls together, in the foreground, and aggregate the reports they return.\r\n\r\n**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:\r\n\r\n- The full diff command and commit list.\r\n- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).\r\n- The brief: \"Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words.\"\r\n\r\n**Spec sub-agent prompt** should include:\r\n\r\n- The diff command and commit list.\r\n- The path or fetched contents of the spec.\r\n- The brief: \"Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words.\"\r\n\r\nIf the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.\r\n\r\n### 5. Aggregate\r\n\r\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).\r\n\r\nEnd with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\r\n\r\n## Why two axes\r\n\r\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\r\n\r\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\r\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\r\n\r\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\r\n\n\nARGUMENTS: Review the uncommitted working-tree changes since HEAD (5cf2937) for issue #22 (MP2plus F5: Site search). Exclude notes/usage-ledger.csv and docs/transcripts/ (the user's files). New untracked files: app/search.js, templates/public/search.html, tests/test_search.py."}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"15d6d001-026b-44a0-b46e-85bf1e667dc2","timestamp":"2026-10-21T04:40:46.410Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_016wcBQ7MKZFHzRngep5zNfG","session_id":"46a8d74b-d860-4909-a43f-d4dbcfcc3476","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"28e2330c-52aa-4363-b1f2-19829f0a52ed","version":"2.1.305","gitBranch":"main"}

If-it-goes-wrong table: \"Works locally, fails on Pages | `fetch(\"/search-index.json\")` | fetch `search-index.json`, relative\".\n\nThe implementation prompt the user gave: \"cms publish writes site/search-index.json from published posts and pages only: title, relative URL, short excerpt. site/search.html loads one plain JavaScript file of at most 60 lines, with relative paths and no library, and the home page links to it. Rules: no href=\"/ or src=\"/ in any template, admin pages included; use url_for or relative links. Every new form carries a CSRF token and refuses a POST without it. Every new setting gets a line in .env.example. If you change the database schema, keep scripts/seed_demo.py running clean ... Tests that existed before may only gain cases ... Put the new tests in tests/test_search.py and name each one test_step<k>_<what> after the acceptance step it checks. Ask before adding any dependency.\"\n\nContext: the user chose to test only at the dev-server-over-HTTP seam (TestClient `client.get(\"/search-index.json\")` etc.), not at `cms publish` directly; step 4 was checked by a scripted Playwright walk outside the test suite (publish with drafts present, `python -m http.server` over the rendered `site/`, follow the home link, search \"Robotics\", one result, click opens the post, at 1280 and 390px — 43/43 checks passed). Either put the full plain text in the index or change the wording.\n  - **Checked and clean:**\n    - No XSS: results are built with `textContent`, and the `href` comes from slugs that `SLUG_RE` has validated.\n    - No draft leak: the index uses `list_published` and `_exportable_pages`.\n    - URLs work when GitHub Pages serves the site from a subfolder.\n    - `/search.html` is declared before `/{slug}.html`, so a Page saved with slug `search` before it was reserved can't hide the search page.\n</agent-message>"}

Plain JavaScript, no library. Every URL is relative, because\n// GitHub Pages serves the site from a subfolder.\n(function () {\n  var input = document.getElementById(\"search-input\");\n  var status = document.getElementById(\"search-status\");\n  var results = document.getElementById(\"search-results\");\n  var index = null;\n\n  // Titles and excerpts are user content: build nodes with textContent,\n  // never innerHTML.\n  function resultRow(item) {\n    var link = document.createElement(\"a\");\n    link.className = \"post-card\";\n    link.href = item.url;\n    var title = document.createElement(\"span\");\n    title.className = \"post-card__title\";\n    title.textContent = item.title;\n    var excerpt = document.createElement(\"span\");\n    excerpt.className = \"post-card__excerpt\";\n    excerpt.textContent = item.excerpt;\n    link.append(title, excerpt);\n    var row = document.createElement(\"li\");\n    row.append(link);\n    return row;\n  }\n\n  function showResults() {\n    var words = input.value.toLowerCase().split(/\\s+/).filter(Boolean);\n    results.replaceChildren();\n    if (index === null || words.length === 0) {\n      status.textContent = \"\";\n      return;\n    }\n    var hits = index.filter(function (item) {\n      var text = (item.title + \" \" + item.excerpt).toLowerCase();\n      return words.every(function (word) { return text.indexOf(word) !== -1; });\n    });\n    results.append.apply(results, hits.map(resultRow));\n    status.textContent = hits.length === 1 ? \"1 result\" :\n      hits.length === 0 ? \"No results\" : hits.length + \" results\";\n  }\n\n  input.addEventListener(\"input\", showResults);\n  fetch(\"search-index.json\")\n    .then(function (response) {\n      if (!response.ok) { throw new Error(\"search index \" + response.status);
