Plain JavaScript, no library. Every URL is relative, because\n// GitHub Pages serves the site from a subfolder.\n(function () {\n  var input = document.getElementById(\"search-input\");\n  var status = document.getElementById(\"search-status\");\n  var results = document.getElementById(\"search-results\");\n  var index = null;\n\n  // Titles and excerpts are user content: build nodes with textContent,\n  // never innerHTML.\n  function result(entry) {\n    var link = document.createElement(\"a\");\n    link.className = \"post-card\";\n    link.href = entry.url;\n    var title = document.createElement(\"span\");\n    title.className = \"post-card__title\";\n    title.textContent = entry.title;\n    var excerpt = document.createElement(\"span\");\n    excerpt.className = \"post-card__excerpt\";\n    excerpt.textContent = entry.excerpt;\n    link.append(title, excerpt);\n    var item = document.createElement(\"li\");\n    item.append(link);\n    return item;\n  }\n\n  function show() {\n    var words = input.value.toLowerCase().split(/\\s+/).filter(Boolean);\n    results.replaceChildren();\n    if (index === null || words.length === 0) {\n      status.textContent = \"\";\n      return;\n    }\n    var hits = index.filter(function (entry) {\n      var text = (entry.title + \" \" + entry.excerpt).toLowerCase();\n      return words.every(function (word) { return text.indexOf(word) !== -1; });\n    });\n    results.append.apply(results, hits.map(result));\n    status.textContent = hits.length === 1 ? \"1 result\" :\n      hits.length === 0 ? \"No results\" : hits.length + \" results\";\n  }\n\n  input.addEventListener(\"input\", show);\n  fetch(\"search-index.json\")\n    .then(function (response) {\n      if (!response.ok) { throw new Error(\"search index \" + response.status); }\n      return response.json();\n    })\n    .then(function (entries) { index = entries; show(); })\n    .catch(function () {\n      status.textContent = \"Search is unavailable: the search index didn't load.\";\n    });\n})();\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"ee4a2f0c-bcc9-43c2-82c1-249b41c3f935","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"46a8d74b-d860-4909-a43f-d4dbcfcc3476","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"28e2330c-52aa-4363-b1f2-19829f0a52ed","version":"2.1.305","gitBranch":"main"}

(file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"0b7f79c9-167a-4852-a494-b93f9ae17845","timestamp":"2026-10-21T05:02:56.867Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\app\\publish.py","oldString":"    entries = [(post, f\"posts/{post['slug']}.html\")\n               for post in content_module.list_published(\"post\")]\n    entries += [(page, f\"{page['slug']}.html\") for page in _exportable_pages()]\n    return json.dumps([\n        {\"title\": item[\"title\"], \"url\": url, \"excerpt\": _excerpt(item[\"body_md\"])}\n        for item, url in entries\n    ], ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)","newString":"    items = [(post, f\"posts/{post['slug']}.html\")\n             for post in content_module.list_published(\"post\")]\n    items += [(page, f\"{page['slug']}.html\") for page in _exportable_pages()]\n    return json.dumps([\n        {\"title\": item[\"title\"], \"url\": url, \"excerpt\": _excerpt(item[\"body_md\"])}\n        for item, url in items\n    ], ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)","originalFile":"\"\"\"Render the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nT00 publishes a placeholder home page. As you build content types, extend\nrender_site() to write one file per published item. Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n     That includes links written in a body: render_markdown(..., to_root=...)\n     rewrites \"/contact-us.html\" and \"media/logo.png\" for the file it lands in.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import content as content_module\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.mdrender import render_markdown, render_text\n\n# One stylesheet for the public site and the admin console (served at /style.css).\nCSS = Path(__file__).with_name(\"style.css\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n# search.html's one script, which searches site/search-index.json.\nSEARCH_JS = Path(__file__).with_name(\"search.js\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n# The most characters of a body that search.html shows under a result's title.\nEXCERPT_LENGTH = 160\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef nav_items(prefix: str = \"\") -> list[dict[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"Published Pages, as relative (title, href) links for the public\n    site's nav. `prefix` relocates the link for a page nested one\n    directory deep (e.g. \"../\" from site/posts/*.html) — a draft Page\n    never appears here.\"\"\"\n    return [{\"title\": page[\"title\"], \"href\": f\"{prefix}{page['slug']}.html\"}\n            for page in _exportable_pages()]\n\n\ndef _exportable_pages() -> list:\n    # The editor already refuses reserved slugs; this also covers rows saved\n    # before that check existed, so a Page can never overwrite site/index.html.\n    return [page for page in content_module.list_published(\"page\")\n            if not content_module.reserved_slug_reason(\"page\", page[\"slug\"])]\n\n\ndef _date(item) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The calendar day an item was created, e.g. \"2026-10-07\".\"\"\"\n    return item[\"created_at\"][:10]\n\n\ndef home_html() -> str:\n    \"\"\"The home page (feed of published Posts), as written to site/index.html.\"\"\"\n    posts = content_module.list_published(\"post\")\n    return environment().get_template(\"public/home.html\").render(\n        title=settings.SITE_TITLE, items=[\n            {\"title\": post[\"title\"], \"href\": f\"posts/{post['slug']}.html\",\n             \"date\": _date(post)} for post in posts\n        ],\n        css_path=\"style.css\", home_path=\"index.html\", nav_items=nav_items(),\n    )\n\n\ndef search_html() -> str:\n    \"\"\"The search page, as written to site/search.html; its script is\n    site/search.js.\"\"\"\n    return environment().get_template(\"public/search.html\").render(\n        title=\"Search\", site_title=settings.SITE_TITLE,\n        css_path=\"style.css\", home_path=\"index.html\", nav_items=nav_items(),\n    )\n\n\ndef search_index_json() -> str:\n    \"\"\"site/search-index.json: the title, URL and a plain-text excerpt of\n    every published Post and Page, for search.html's script to search. Each\n    URL is relative to the site root, where search.html is.\"\"\"\n    entries = [(post, f\"posts/{post['slug']}.html\")\n               for post in content_module.list_published(\"post\")]\n    entries += [(page, f\"{page['slug']}.html\") for page in _exportable_pages()]\n    return json.dumps([\n        {\"title\": item[\"title\"], \"url\": url, \"excerpt\": _excerpt(item[\"body_md\"])}\n        for item, url in entries\n    ], ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)\n\n\ndef _excerpt(body_md: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The start of a body as plain text, cut at a word break to\n    EXCERPT_LENGTH characters or fewer, then \"…\" if anything was cut.\"\"\"\n    text = render_text(body_md)\n    if len(text) <= EXCERPT_LENGTH:\n        return text\n    return text[:EXCERPT_LENGTH + 1].rsplit(\" \", 1)[0][:EXCERPT_LENGTH].rstrip(\" .,;:\") + \"…\"\n\n\ndef post_html(post) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A published Post, as written to site/posts/<slug>.html — one directory\n    deep, so every shared link climbs a level.\"\"\"\n    return _detail_html(\"public/post.html\", \"post\", post, prefix=\"../\")\n\n\ndef page_html(page) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A published Page, as written to site/<slug>.html.\"\"\"\n    return _detail_html(\"public/page.html\", \"page\", page, prefix=\"\")\n\n\ndef _detail_html(template_name: str, item_key: str, item, *, prefix: str) -> str:\n    return environment().get_template(template_name).render(\n        title=item[\"title\"], site_title=settings.SITE_TITLE,\n        **{item_key: item}, date=_date(item),\n        body_html=render_markdown(item[\"body_md\"], to_root=prefix),\n        css_path=f\"{prefix}style.css\", home_path=f\"{prefix}index.html\",\n        nav_items=nav_items(prefix=prefix),\n    )\n\n\ndef _write(path: Path, text: str) -> None:\n    # Explicit UTF-8: the pages declare <meta charset=\"utf-8\">, and the\n    # platform default (cp1252 on Windows) can't encode an emoji at all.\n    path.write_text(text, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    _write(out / \"style.css\", CSS)\n    _write(out / \"index.html\", home_html())\n    _write(out / \"search.html\", search_html())\n    _write(out / \"search.js\", SEARCH_JS)\n    _write(out / \"search-index.json\", search_index_json())\n\n    posts_dir = out / \"posts\"\n    posts_dir.mkdir()\n    for post in content_module.list_published(\"post\"):\n        _write(posts_dir / f\"{post['slug']}.html\", post_html(post))\n    for page in _exportable_pages():\n        _write(out / f\"{page['slug']}.html\", page_html(page))\n\n    # Every file in media/ is meant to be public; Posts show them through\n    # their Media library snippets.\n    if settings.MEDIA.is_dir():\n        shutil.copytree(settings.MEDIA, out / \"media\")\n\n    return out\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":83,"oldLines":12,"newStart":83,"newLines":12,"lines":["     \"\"\"site/search-index.json: the title, URL and a plain-text excerpt of","     every published Post and Page, for search.html's script to search. Both render\nthrough app.publish, so the local preview and the deployed site can't drift.\nOnly published content is ever served; a draft's URL is a 404.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, Response\n\nfrom app import content as content_module\nfrom app.publish import (\n    CSS, SEARCH_JS, home_html, page_html, post_html, search_html, search_index_json,\n)\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\n@router.get(\"/\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n@router.get(\"/index.html\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\ndef home():\n    return home_html()\n\n\n@router.get(\"/style.css\")\ndef style_css():\n    return Response(CSS, media_type=\"text/css\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/search.html\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\ndef search_page():\n    return search_html()\n\n\n@router.get(\"/search.js\")\ndef search_js():\n    return Response(SEARCH_JS, media_type=\"text/javascript\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/search-index.json\")\ndef search_index():\n    return Response(search_index_json(), media_type=\"application/json\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/posts/{slug}.html\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\ndef public_post(slug: str):\n    post = content_module.get_published_by_slug(\"post\", slug)\n    if post is None:\n        raise HTTPException(404)\n    return post_html(post)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{slug}.html\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\ndef public_page(slug: str):\n    page = content_module.get_published_by_slug(\"page\", slug)\n    if page is None:\n        raise HTTPException(404)\n    return page_html(page)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":1,"oldLines":6,"newStart":1,"newLines":7,"lines":[" \"\"\"The public site, served live by the dev server at the same paths the static","-export writes (index.html, posts/<slug>.html, <slug>.html). (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"b34177c0-ff2a-4de4-b385-2dea6e104362","timestamp":"2026-10-21T05:02:57.352Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\app\\mdrender.py","oldString":"Both make a Media library image (`media/<file>`) relative to the page it is\nshown on.\n\"\"\"","newString":"Both make a Media library image (`media/<file>`) relative to the page it is\nshown on. `render_text` reads the same Markdown as plain text, for the\nsearch index's excerpts.\n\"\"\"","originalFile":"\"\"\"Markdown -> sanitized HTML: the one pipeline the admin preview and the\nlater static export (T07) both reuse, so a post can't render one way in the\neditor and another way once published. The one deliberate difference is a\nlink to the site root, which the export makes relative (`to_root` below).\nBoth make a Media library image (`media/<file>`) relative to the page it is\nshown on.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom html import unescape\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\n\n_md = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\")\n\n# What a browser ignores before it reads a URL (WHATWG URL parsing): spaces\n# and control characters at either end, and tabs and newlines anywhere.\n_TRIMMED = \"\".join(chr(code) for code in range(0x21))\n_DROPPED = {ord(\"\\t\"): None, ord(\"\\n\"): None, ord(\"\\r\"): None}\n\n\ndef render_markdown(\n    raw: str, *, to_root: str | None = None, media_root: str | None = None,\n) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render Markdown to HTML, then strip anything unsafe (script tags,\n    event-handler attributes like onerror=, javascript: URLs, ...).\n\n    `to_root` is set when the HTML is written into site/: the \"../\" steps\n    from that file back to the site root (\"\" for a Page, \"../\" for a Post).\n    A link written in a body from the site root (`/contact-us.html`), and a\n    library snippet's image (`media/team.png`), are then made relative to the\n    file, because GitHub Pages serves the site from a subfolder.\n\n    Unset (the admin preview), links stay as written: the admin server\n    serves the public pages at its own root, so they resolve there. Only a\n    `media/` URL is rewritten, by `media_root`: the \"../\" steps from the admin\n    page the preview is shown on back to the server root, which serves media/.\n    \"\"\"\n    html = _md.render(raw)\n    if to_root is not None:\n        return nh3.clean(html, attribute_filter=_link_rewriter(to_root, root_links=True))\n    if media_root is not None:\n        return nh3.clean(html, attribute_filter=_link_rewriter(media_root, root_links=False))\n    return nh3.clean(html)\n\n\ndef render_text(raw: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The words of `raw` as a reader sees them on the page, with no markup:\n    every tag dropped (a <script> or <style> with its contents), entities\n    decoded, and whitespace runs collapsed to one space.\"\"\"\n    text = nh3.clean(_md.render(raw), tags=set())\n    return \" \".join(unescape(text).split())\n\n\ndef _link_rewriter(to_root: str, *, root_links: bool) -> Callable[[str, str, str], str]:\n    \"\"\"An nh3 attribute filter that makes every href/src starting `media/`\n    relative to the page, and, with `root_links`, every one a browser would\n    read as root-absolute or protocol-relative too.\n\n    nh3 checks URL schemes before it calls the filter, never after, so a\n    rewritten value must never be able to start a scheme: it always begins\n    with \"./\", \"../\" or \"https://\". Dropping only the \"/\" would turn\n    \"/javascript:alert(1)\" into a live javascript: link.\n    \"\"\"\n    prefix = to_root or \"./\"\n\n    def rewrite(tag: str, attribute: str, value: str) -> str:\n        if attribute not in (\"href\", \"src\"):\n            return value\n        url = value.strip(_TRIMMED).translate(_DROPPED).replace(\"\\\\\", \"/\")\n        if url.startswith(\"media/\"):\n            return prefix + url  # a Media library snippet names it from the site root\n        if not root_links:\n            return value\n        if url.startswith(\"//\"):\n            return \"https:\" + url  # protocol-relative; GitHub Pages is HTTPS-only\n        if url.startswith(\"/\"):\n            rest = url[1:]\n            if rest == \"\" or rest[0] in \"#?\":\n                rest = \"index.html\" + rest  # \"/\" is the home page\n            return prefix + rest\n        return value\n\n    return rewrite\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":3,"oldLines":7,"newStart":3,"newLines":8,"lines":[" editor and another way once published. The one deliberate difference is a"," link to the site root, which the export makes relative (`to_root` below)."," Both make a Media library image (`media/<file>`) relative to the page it is","-shown on.","+shown on. `render_text` reads the same Markdown as plain text, for the","+search index's excerpts."," \"\"\""," from __future__ import annotations"," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"9434e7b6-2604-41ae-b199-4ac73c8b5df6","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"46a8d74b-d860-4909-a43f-d4dbcfcc3476","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"28e2330c-52aa-4363-b1f2-19829f0a52ed","version":"2.1.305","gitBranch":"main"}

Plain JavaScript, no library. Every URL is relative, because\n// GitHub Pages serves the site from a subfolder.\n(function () {\n  var input = document.getElementById(\"search-input\");\n  var status = document.getElementById(\"search-status\");\n  var results = document.getElementById(\"search-results\");\n  var index = null;\n\n  // Titles and excerpts are user content: build nodes with textContent,\n  // never innerHTML.\n  function resultRow(item) {\n    var link = document.createElement(\"a\");\n    link.className = \"post-card\";\n    link.href = item.url;\n    var title = document.createElement(\"span\");\n    title.className = \"post-card__title\";\n    title.textContent = item.title;\n    var excerpt = document.createElement(\"span\");\n    excerpt.className = \"post-card__excerpt\";\n    excerpt.textContent = item.excerpt;\n    link.append(title, excerpt);\n    var row = document.createElement(\"li\");\n    row.append(link);\n    return row;\n  }\n\n  function showResults() {\n    var words = input.value.toLowerCase().split(/\\s+/).filter(Boolean);\n    results.replaceChildren();\n    if (index === null || words.length === 0) {\n      status.textContent = \"\";\n      return;\n    }\n    var hits = index.filter(function (item) {\n      var text = (item.title + \" \" + item.excerpt).toLowerCase();\n      return words.every(function (word) { return text.indexOf(word) !== -1; });\n    });\n    results.append.apply(results, hits.map(resultRow));\n    status.textContent = hits.length === 1 ? \"1 result\" :\n      hits.length === 0 ? \"No results\" : hits.length + \" results\";\n  }\n\n  input.addEventListener(\"input\", showResults);\n  fetch(\"search-index.json\")\n    .then(function (response) {\n      if (!response.ok) { throw new Error(\"search index \" + response.status); }\n      return response.json();\n    })\n    .then(function (items) { index = items; showResults(); })\n    .catch(function () {\n      status.textContent = \"Search is unavailable: the search index didn't load.\";\n    });\n})();\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01NedZcM4ZoqpmoiSzK5McWW","name":"Edit","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\app\\publish.py","old_string":"    entries = [(post, f\"posts/{post['slug']}.html\")\n               for post in content_module.list_published(\"post\")]\n    entries += [(page, f\"{page['slug']}.html\") for page in _exportable_pages()]\n    return json.dumps([\n        {\"title\": item[\"title\"], \"url\": url, \"excerpt\": _excerpt(item[\"body_md\"])}\n        for item, url in entries\n    ], ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)","new_string":"    items = [(post, f\"posts/{post['slug']}.html\")\n             for post in content_module.list_published(\"post\")]\n    items += [(page, f\"{page['slug']}.html\") for page in _exportable_pages()]\n    return json.dumps([\n        {\"title\": item[\"title\"], \"url\": url, \"excerpt\": _excerpt(item[\"body_md\"])}\n        for item, url in items\n    ], ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01MuyGv9S3BUwvWoJQJCZ7Gf","name":"Edit","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\app\\routes\\public.py","old_string":"\"\"\"The public site, served live by the dev server at the same paths the static\nexport writes (index.html, posts/<slug>.html, <slug>.html). The dev server\nserves the same files at the same paths, through the same app.publish code,\nso these tests read them over HTTP. Each test is named after the acceptance\nstep on #22 it checks.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom html import unescape\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit\n\nfrom app import content as content_module\nfrom app import db as db_module\nfrom tests.conftest import extract_csrf\n\nBASE = \"http://testserver\"\n\n\ndef _admin_id() -> int:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'admin@example.test'\"\n        ).fetchone()[\"id\"]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef _seed(kind: str, title: str, slug: str, body_md: str, status: str = \"published\") -> int:\n    content_id = content_module.create_content(kind, title, slug, body_md, _admin_id())\n    if status == \"published\":\n        content_module.set_status(content_id, kind, \"published\")\n    return content_id\n\n\n# -- Step 1: the index has the title, relative URL and a short excerpt of each\n#    published Post and Page --\n\ndef test_step1_the_index_lists_each_published_post_and_page(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"robotics-kickoff\", \"Meet us in room 204.\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"About us\", \"about-us\", \"We promote computer science.\")\n\n    response = client.get(\"/search-index.json\")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"application/json\")\n    assert response.json() == [\n        {\"title\": \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"url\": \"posts/robotics-kickoff.html\",\n         \"excerpt\": \"Meet us in room 204.\"},\n        {\"title\": \"About us\", \"url\": \"about-us.html\",\n         \"excerpt\": \"We promote computer science.\"},\n    ]\n\n\ndef test_step1_the_excerpt_is_short_plain_text(client):\n    body = (\"# Welcome\\n\\nJoin **CS Honor Society** & meet [our officers](/about-us.html).\"\n            \"\\n\\n<script>alert(1)</script>\\n\\n\" + \"lorem \" * 80)\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Welcome\", \"welcome\", body)\n\n    excerpt = client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json()[0][\"excerpt\"]\n\n    assert excerpt.startswith(\"Welcome Join CS Honor Society & meet our officers. lorem lorem\")\n    assert \"<\" not in excerpt and \"alert\" not in excerpt and \"&amp;\" not in excerpt\n    assert len(excerpt) <= 161 and excerpt.endswith(\"lorem…\"), excerpt\n\n\n# -- Step 2: Drafts are absent from the index --\n\ndef test_step2_drafts_are_absent_from_the_index(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Live post\", \"live-post\", \"Public words.\")\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Secret draft post\", \"secret-post\", \"Hidden words.\", status=\"draft\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"Secret draft page\", \"secret-page\", \"Hidden words.\", status=\"draft\")\n    scheduled = _seed(\"post\", \"Secret scheduled post\", \"secret-scheduled\", \"Hidden words.\",\n                      status=\"draft\")\n    content_module.set_schedule(scheduled, \"post\", \"2099-01-01 00:00:00\")\n    unpublished = _seed(\"page\", \"Secret unpublished page\", \"secret-unpublished\", \"Hidden words.\")\n    content_module.set_status(unpublished, \"page\", \"draft\")\n\n    response = client.get(\"/search-index.json\")\n\n    assert [entry[\"title\"] for entry in response.json()] == [\"Live post\"]\n    assert \"secret\" not in response.text.lower() and \"hidden\" not in response.text.lower()\n\n\n# -- Step 3: search.html loads one plain JavaScript file of 60 lines or fewer,\n#    with no external dependency and relative paths only --\n\ndef _is_relative(url: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"True for a URL that resolves against the page it is on: no scheme,\n    no host, and no leading slash.\"\"\"\n    parts = urlsplit(url)\n    return not (parts.scheme or parts.netloc or url.startswith((\"/\", \"\\\\\")))\n\n\ndef _scripts(html: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(attributes, inline code) of every <script> element in `html`.\"\"\"\n    return re.findall(r\"<script\\b([^>]*)>(.*?)</script\\s*>\", html, re.S | re.I)\n\n\ndef test_step3_search_html_loads_one_local_script_of_at_most_60_lines(client):\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\")\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n\n    [(attributes, inline)] = _scripts(page.text)\n    assert inline.strip() == \"\"\n    src = unescape(re.search(r'\\bsrc=\"([^\"]*)\"', attributes).group(1))\n    assert _is_relative(src), src\n    script = client.get(urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/search.html\", src)).path)\n    assert script.status_code == 200\n    assert \"javascript\" in script.headers[\"content-type\"]\n    assert len(script.text.splitlines()) <= 60\n\n\ndef test_step3_search_html_and_its_script_use_only_relative_urls(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"robotics-kickoff\", \"Meet us in room 204.\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"About us\", \"about-us\", \"We promote computer science.\")\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\").text\n\n    urls = [unescape(url) for url in re.findall(r'\\b(?:href|src)=\"([^\"]*)\"', page)]\n    assert urls and all(_is_relative(url) for url in urls), urls\n    [(attributes, _)] = _scripts(page)\n    src = unescape(re.search(r'\\bsrc=\"([^\"]*)\"', attributes).group(1))\n    script = client.get(urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/search.html\", src)).path).text\n    # No library pulled in, and no string the script could fetch from the root\n    # or another host (\"/search-index.json\" fails on a Pages subfolder).\n    assert not re.search(r\"\\b(import|require)\\s*\\(|\\bimport\\s\", script)\n    assert \"://\" not in script\n    assert not re.search(r\"\"\"[\"'`]/\"\"\", script), \"a string in the script starts with /\"\n    assert all(_is_relative(entry[\"url\"]) for entry in client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json())\n\n\ndef test_step3_a_page_cannot_take_the_search_slug(client_as):\n    # A Page is exported to site/<slug>.html, so slug \"search\" would\n    # overwrite the search page.\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = editor.post(\"/admin/pages/new\", data={\n        \"title\": \"Search\", \"slug\": \"search\", \"body_md\": \"x\",\n        \"csrf_token\": extract_csrf(editor.get(\"/admin/pages/new\").text),\n    })\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"reserved\" in response.text.lower()\n    assert content_module.list_content(\"page\") == []\n\n\ndef test_step3_a_page_saved_with_the_search_slug_before_it_was_reserved_is_left_out(client):\n    _seed(\"page\", \"Old search page\", \"search\", \"Saved before the slug was reserved.\")\n\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\").text\n\n    assert \"Old search page\" not in page and len(_scripts(page)) == 1\n    assert client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json() == []\n\n\n# -- Step 5: the published home page links to search.html with a relative path --\n\ndef test_step5_the_home_page_links_to_search_html_with_a_relative_path(client):\n    home = client.get(\"/index.html\").text\n\n    hrefs = [unescape(href) for href in re.findall(r'<a\\b[^>]*\\bhref=\"([^\"]*)\"', home)]\n    search_links = [href for href in hrefs\n                    if urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/index.html\", href)).path == \"/search.html\"]\n    assert search_links, hrefs\n    assert all(_is_relative(href) for href in search_links), search_links\n    assert client.get(\"/search.html\").status_code == The dev server\nserves the same files at the same paths, through the same app.publish code,\nso these tests read them over HTTP. Each test is named after the acceptance\nstep on #22 it checks.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom html import unescape\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit\n\nfrom app import content as content_module\nfrom app import db as db_module\nfrom tests.conftest import extract_csrf\n\nBASE = \"http://testserver\"\n\n\ndef _admin_id() -> int:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'admin@example.test'\"\n        ).fetchone()[\"id\"]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef _seed(kind: str, title: str, slug: str, body_md: str, status: str = \"published\") -> int:\n    content_id = content_module.create_content(kind, title, slug, body_md, _admin_id())\n    if status == \"published\":\n        content_module.set_status(content_id, kind, \"published\")\n    return content_id\n\n\n# -- Step 1: the index has the title, relative URL and a short excerpt of each\n#    published Post and Page --\n\ndef test_step1_the_index_lists_each_published_post_and_page(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"robotics-kickoff\", \"Meet us in room 204.\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"About us\", \"about-us\", \"We promote computer science.\")\n\n    response = client.get(\"/search-index.json\")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"application/json\")\n    assert response.json() == [\n        {\"title\": \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"url\": \"posts/robotics-kickoff.html\",\n         \"excerpt\": \"Meet us in room 204.\"},\n        {\"title\": \"About us\", \"url\": \"about-us.html\",\n         \"excerpt\": \"We promote computer science.\"},\n    ]\n\n\ndef test_step1_the_excerpt_is_short_plain_text(client):\n    body = (\"# Welcome\\n\\nJoin **CS Honor Society** & meet [our officers](/about-us.html).\"\n            \"\\n\\n<script>alert(1)</script>\\n\\n\" + \"lorem \" * 80)\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Welcome\", \"welcome\", body)\n\n    excerpt = client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json()[0][\"excerpt\"]\n\n    assert excerpt.startswith(\"Welcome Join CS Honor Society & meet our officers. lorem lorem\")\n    assert \"<\" not in excerpt and \"alert\" not in excerpt and \"&amp;\" not in excerpt\n    assert len(excerpt) <= 161 and excerpt.endswith(\"lorem…\"), excerpt\n\n\n# -- Step 2: Drafts are absent from the index --\n\ndef test_step2_drafts_are_absent_from_the_index(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Live post\", \"live-post\", \"Public words.\")\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Secret draft post\", \"secret-post\", \"Hidden words.\", status=\"draft\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"Secret draft page\", \"secret-page\", \"Hidden words.\", status=\"draft\")\n    scheduled = _seed(\"post\", \"Secret scheduled post\", \"secret-scheduled\", \"Hidden words.\",\n                      status=\"draft\")\n    content_module.set_schedule(scheduled, \"post\", \"2099-01-01 00:00:00\")\n    unpublished = _seed(\"page\", \"Secret unpublished page\", \"secret-unpublished\", \"Hidden words.\")\n    content_module.set_status(unpublished, \"page\", \"draft\")\n\n    response = client.get(\"/search-index.json\")\n\n    assert [item[\"title\"] for item in response.json()] == [\"Live post\"]\n    assert \"secret\" not in response.text.lower() and \"hidden\" not in response.text.lower()\n\n\n# -- Step 3: search.html loads one plain JavaScript file of 60 lines or fewer,\n#    with no external dependency and relative paths only --\n\ndef _is_relative(url: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"True for a URL that resolves against the page it is on: no scheme,\n    no host, and no leading slash.\"\"\"\n    parts = urlsplit(url)\n    return not (parts.scheme or parts.netloc or url.startswith((\"/\", \"\\\\\")))\n\n\ndef _scripts(html: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(attributes, inline code) of every <script> element in `html`.\"\"\"\n    return re.findall(r\"<script\\b([^>]*)>(.*?)</script\\s*>\", html, re.S | re.I)\n\n\ndef test_step3_search_html_loads_one_local_script_of_at_most_60_lines(client):\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\")\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n\n    [(attributes, inline)] = _scripts(page.text)\n    assert inline.strip() == \"\"\n    src = unescape(re.search(r'\\bsrc=\"([^\"]*)\"', attributes).group(1))\n    assert _is_relative(src), src\n    script = client.get(urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/search.html\", src)).path)\n    assert script.status_code == 200\n    assert \"javascript\" in script.headers[\"content-type\"]\n    assert len(script.text.splitlines()) <= 60\n\n\ndef test_step3_search_html_and_its_script_use_only_relative_urls(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"robotics-kickoff\", \"Meet us in room 204.\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"About us\", \"about-us\", \"We promote computer science.\")\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\").text\n\n    urls = [unescape(url) for url in re.findall(r'\\b(?:href|src)=\"([^\"]*)\"', page)]\n    assert urls and all(_is_relative(url) for url in urls), urls\n    [(attributes, _)] = _scripts(page)\n    src = unescape(re.search(r'\\bsrc=\"([^\"]*)\"', attributes).group(1))\n    script = client.get(urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/search.html\", src)).path).text\n    # No library pulled in, and no string the script could fetch from the root\n    # or another host (\"/search-index.json\" fails on a Pages subfolder).\n    assert not re.search(r\"\\b(import|require)\\s*\\(|\\bimport\\s\", script)\n    assert \"://\" not in script\n    assert not re.search(r\"\"\"[\"'`]/\"\"\", script), \"a string in the script starts with /\"\n    assert all(_is_relative(item[\"url\"]) for item in client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json())\n\n\n# A Page is exported to site/<slug>.html, so a Page with slug \"search\" would\n# overwrite site/search.html and its script with the Page's own text.\n\ndef test_step3_a_page_cannot_take_the_search_slug_and_replace_search_html(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = editor.post(\"/admin/pages/new\", data={\n        \"title\": \"Search\", \"slug\": \"search\", \"body_md\": \"x\",\n        \"csrf_token\": extract_csrf(editor.get(\"/admin/pages/new\").text),\n    })\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"reserved\" in response.text.lower()\n    assert content_module.list_content(\"page\") == []\n\n\ndef test_step3_a_page_saved_with_the_search_slug_before_it_was_reserved_is_left_out(client):\n    _seed(\"page\", \"Old search page\", \"search\", \"Saved before the slug was reserved.\")\n\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\").text\n\n    assert \"Old search page\" not in page and len(_scripts(page)) == 1\n    assert client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json() == []\n\n\n# -- Step 5: the published home page links to search.html with a relative path --\n\ndef test_step5_the_home_page_links_to_search_html_with_a_relative_path(client):\n    home = client.get(\"/index.html\").text\n\n    hrefs = [unescape(href) for href in re.findall(r'<a\\b[^>]*\\bhref=\"([^\"]*)\"', home)]\n    search_links = [href for href in hrefs\n                    if urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/index.html\", href)).path == \"/search.html\"]\n    assert search_links, hrefs\n    assert all(_is_relative(href) for href in search_links), search_links\n    assert client.get(\"/search.html\").status_code == The dev server\nserves the same files at the same paths, through the same app.publish code,\nso these tests read them over HTTP. Each test is named after the acceptance\nstep on #22 it checks.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom html import unescape\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit\n\nfrom app import content as content_module\nfrom app import db as db_module\nfrom tests.conftest import extract_csrf\n\nBASE = \"http://testserver\"\n\n\ndef _admin_id() -> int:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'admin@example.test'\"\n        ).fetchone()[\"id\"]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef _seed(kind: str, title: str, slug: str, body_md: str, status: str = \"published\") -> int:\n    content_id = content_module.create_content(kind, title, slug, body_md, _admin_id())\n    if status == \"published\":\n        content_module.set_status(content_id, kind, \"published\")\n    return content_id\n\n\n# -- Step 1: the index has the title, relative URL and a short excerpt of each\n#    published Post and Page --\n\ndef test_step1_the_index_lists_each_published_post_and_page(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"robotics-kickoff\", \"Meet us in room 204.\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"About us\", \"about-us\", \"We promote computer science.\")\n\n    response = client.get(\"/search-index.json\")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"application/json\")\n    assert response.json() == [\n        {\"title\": \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"url\": \"posts/robotics-kickoff.html\",\n         \"excerpt\": \"Meet us in room 204.\"},\n        {\"title\": \"About us\", \"url\": \"about-us.html\",\n         \"excerpt\": \"We promote computer science.\"},\n    ]\n\n\ndef test_step1_the_excerpt_is_short_plain_text(client):\n    body = (\"# Welcome\\n\\nJoin **CS Honor Society** & meet [our officers](/about-us.html).\"\n            \"\\n\\n<script>alert(1)</script>\\n\\n\" + \"lorem \" * 80)\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Welcome\", \"welcome\", body)\n\n    excerpt = client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json()[0][\"excerpt\"]\n\n    assert excerpt.startswith(\"Welcome Join CS Honor Society & meet our officers. lorem lorem\")\n    assert \"<\" not in excerpt and \"alert\" not in excerpt and \"&amp;\" not in excerpt\n    assert len(excerpt) <= 161 and excerpt.endswith(\"lorem…\"), excerpt\n\n\ndef _publish(monkeypatch, tmp_path) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Run `cms publish` into a temporary site/ and return it.\"\"\"\n    site = tmp_path / \"site\"\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"SITE\", site)\n    assert cli.main([\"publish\"]) == 0\n    return site\n\n\ndef test_step1_cms_publish_writes_the_index_and_search_page_the_dev_server_serves(\n    client, monkeypatch, tmp_path,\n):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"robotics-kickoff\", \"Meet us in room 204.\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"About us\", \"about-us\", \"We promote computer science.\")\n\n    site = _publish(monkeypatch, tmp_path)\n\n    index = json.loads((site / \"search-index.json\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    assert [item[\"title\"] for item in index] == [\"Robotics club kickoff\", \"About us\"]\n    assert index == client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json()\n    for name in (\"search.html\", \"search.js\"):\n        assert (site / name).read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\") == client.get(f\"/{name}\").text\n\n\n# -- Step 2: Drafts are absent from the index --\n\ndef test_step2_drafts_are_absent_from_the_index(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Live post\", \"live-post\", \"Public words.\")\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Secret draft post\", \"secret-post\", \"Hidden words.\", status=\"draft\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"Secret draft page\", \"secret-page\", \"Hidden words.\", status=\"draft\")\n    scheduled = _seed(\"post\", \"Secret scheduled post\", \"secret-scheduled\", \"Hidden words.\",\n                      status=\"draft\")\n    content_module.set_schedule(scheduled, \"post\", \"2099-01-01 00:00:00\")\n    unpublished = _seed(\"page\", \"Secret unpublished page\", \"secret-unpublished\", \"Hidden words.\")\n    content_module.set_status(unpublished, \"page\", \"draft\")\n\n    response = client.get(\"/search-index.json\")\n\n    assert [item[\"title\"] for item in response.json()] == [\"Live post\"]\n    assert \"secret\" not in response.text.lower() and \"hidden\" not in response.text.lower()\n\n\n# -- Step 3: search.html loads one plain JavaScript file of 60 lines or fewer,\n#    with no external dependency and relative paths only --\n\ndef _is_relative(url: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"True for a URL that resolves against the page it is on: no scheme,\n    no host, and no leading slash.\"\"\"\n    parts = urlsplit(url)\n    return not (parts.scheme or parts.netloc or url.startswith((\"/\", \"\\\\\")))\n\n\ndef _scripts(html: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(attributes, inline code) of every <script> element in `html`.\"\"\"\n    return re.findall(r\"<script\\b([^>]*)>(.*?)</script\\s*>\", html, re.S | re.I)\n\n\ndef test_step3_search_html_loads_one_local_script_of_at_most_60_lines(client):\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\")\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n\n    [(attributes, inline)] = _scripts(page.text)\n    assert inline.strip() == \"\"\n    src = unescape(re.search(r'\\bsrc=\"([^\"]*)\"', attributes).group(1))\n    assert _is_relative(src), src\n    script = client.get(urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/search.html\", src)).path)\n    assert script.status_code == 200\n    assert \"javascript\" in script.headers[\"content-type\"]\n    assert len(script.text.splitlines()) <= 60\n\n\ndef test_step3_search_html_and_its_script_use_only_relative_urls(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"robotics-kickoff\", \"Meet us in room 204.\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"About us\", \"about-us\", \"We promote computer science.\")\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\").text\n\n    urls = [unescape(url) for url in re.findall(r'\\b(?:href|src)=\"([^\"]*)\"', page)]\n    assert urls and all(_is_relative(url) for url in urls), urls\n    [(attributes, _)] = _scripts(page)\n    src = unescape(re.search(r'\\bsrc=\"([^\"]*)\"', attributes).group(1))\n    script = client.get(urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/search.html\", src)).path).text\n    # No library pulled in, and no string the script could fetch from the root\n    # or another host (\"/search-index.json\" fails on a Pages subfolder).\n    assert not re.search(r\"\\b(import|require)\\s*\\(|\\bimport\\s\", script)\n    assert \"://\" not in script\n    assert not re.search(r\"\"\"[\"'`]/\"\"\", script), \"a string in the script starts with /\"\n    assert all(_is_relative(item[\"url\"]) for item in client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json())\n\n\n# A Page is exported to site/<slug>.html, so a Page with slug \"search\" would\n# overwrite site/search.html and its script with the Page's own text.\n\ndef test_step3_a_page_cannot_take_the_search_slug_and_replace_search_html(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = editor.post(\"/admin/pages/new\", data={\n        \"title\": \"Search\", \"slug\": \"search\", \"body_md\": \"x\",\n        \"csrf_token\": extract_csrf(editor.get(\"/admin/pages/new\").text),\n    })\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"reserved\" in response.text.lower()\n    assert content_module.list_content(\"page\") == []\n\n\ndef test_step3_an_older_page_with_the_search_slug_cannot_replace_search_html(client):\n    # Saved before \"search\" was reserved, which the editor no longer allows.\n    _seed(\"page\", \"Old search page\", \"search\", \"Saved before the slug was reserved.\")\n\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\").text\n\n    assert \"Old search page\" not in page and len(_scripts(page)) == 1\n    assert client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json() == []\n\n\n# -- Step 5: the published home page links to search.html with a relative path --\n\ndef test_step5_the_home_page_links_to_search_html_with_a_relative_path(client):\n    home = client.get(\"/index.html\").text\n\n    hrefs = [unescape(href) for href in re.findall(r'<a\\b[^>]*\\bhref=\"([^\"]*)\"', home)]\n    search_links = [href for href in hrefs\n                    if urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/index.html\", href)).path == \"/search.html\"]\n    assert search_links, hrefs\n    assert all(_is_relative(href) for href in search_links), search_links\n    assert client.get(\"/search.html\").status_code == 200\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":109,"oldLines":6,"newStart":109,"newLines":20,"lines":["     assert \"secret\" not in response.text.lower() and \"hidden\" not in response.text.lower()"," "," test_step3_search_html_loads_one_local_script_of_at_most_60_lines(client):\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\")\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n\n    [(attributes, inline)] = len(script.text.splitlines()) <= 60\n\n\ndef test_step3_search_html_and_its_script_use_only_relative_urls(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"robotics-kickoff\", \"Meet us in script could fetch from the root\n    # or another host (\"/search-index.json\" fails on a Pages subfolder).\n    assert not re.search(r\"\\b(import|require)\\s*\\(|\\bimport\\s\", script)\n    assert client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json())\n\n\n# A Page is exported to site/<slug>.html, so a Page with slug \"search\" would\n# overwrite site/search.html and its script with the Page's own assert \"reserved\" in response.text.lower()\n    assert content_module.list_content(\"page\") == []\n\n\ndef test_step3_an_older_page_with_the_search_slug_cannot_replace_search_html(client):\n    # \"http://testserver\"\n\n\ndef _admin_id() -> int:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'admin@example.test'\"\n        ).fetchone()[\"id\"]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef _seed(kind: str, title: str, slug: str, body_md: str, status: str = \"published\") -> int:\n    content_id = content_module.create_content(kind, title, slug, body_md, _admin_id())\n    if status == \"published\":\n        content_module.set_status(content_id, kind, \"published\")\n    return test_step1_the_index_lists_each_published_post_and_page(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"robotics-kickoff\", \"Meet us in room 204.\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"About us\", \"about-us\", \"We promote computer science.\")\n\n    response = client.get(\"/search-index.json\")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"application/json\")\n    assert response.json() == [\n        {\"title\": \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"url\": \"posts/robotics-kickoff.html\",\n test_step1_the_excerpt_is_short_plain_text(client):\n    body = (\"# Welcome\\n\\nJoin **CS Honor Society** & meet [our officers](/about-us.html).\"\n            \"\\n\\n<script>alert(1)</script>\\n\\n\" + \"lorem \" * 80)\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Welcome\", \"welcome\", body)\n\n    excerpt = client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json()[0][\"excerpt\"]\n\n the home page links to search.html. The dev server\nserves the same files at the same paths, through the same app.publish code,\nso most tests read them over HTTP; two run `cms publish` itself. Each test is\nnamed after the acceptance step on #22 it checks.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport re\nfrom html import unescape\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit\n\nfrom app import cli, settings\nfrom app import content as content_module\nfrom app import db as db_module\nfrom tests.conftest import extract_csrf\n\nBASE = \"http://testserver\"\n\n\ndef _admin_id() -> int:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'admin@example.test'\"\n        ).fetchone()[\"id\"]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef _seed(kind: str, title: str, slug: str, body_md: str, status: str = \"published\") -> int:\n    content_id = content_module.create_content(kind, title, slug, body_md, _admin_id())\n    if status == \"published\":\n        content_module.set_status(content_id, kind, \"published\")\n    return content_id\n\n\n# -- Step 1: the index has the title, relative URL and a short excerpt of each\n#    published Post and Page --\n\ndef test_step1_the_index_lists_each_published_post_and_page(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"robotics-kickoff\", \"Meet us in room 204.\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"About us\", \"about-us\", \"We promote computer science.\")\n\n    response = client.get(\"/search-index.json\")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"application/json\")\n    assert response.json() == [\n        {\"title\": \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"url\": \"posts/robotics-kickoff.html\",\n         \"excerpt\": \"Meet us in room 204.\"},\n        {\"title\": \"About us\", \"url\": \"about-us.html\",\n         \"excerpt\": \"We promote computer science.\"},\n    ]\n\n\ndef test_step1_the_excerpt_is_short_plain_text(client):\n    body = (\"# Welcome\\n\\nJoin **CS Honor Society** & meet [our officers](/about-us.html).\"\n            \"\\n\\n<script>alert(1)</script>\\n\\n\" + \"lorem \" * 80)\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Welcome\", \"welcome\", body)\n\n    excerpt = client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json()[0][\"excerpt\"]\n\n    assert excerpt.startswith(\"Welcome Join CS Honor Society & meet our officers. lorem lorem\")\n    assert \"<\" not in excerpt and \"alert\" not in excerpt and \"&amp;\" not in excerpt\n    assert len(excerpt) <= 161 and excerpt.endswith(\"lorem…\"), excerpt\n\n\ndef _publish(monkeypatch, tmp_path) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Run `cms publish` into a temporary site/ and return it.\"\"\"\n    site = tmp_path / \"site\"\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"SITE\", site)\n    assert cli.main([\"publish\"]) == 0\n    return site\n\n\ndef test_step1_cms_publish_writes_the_index_and_search_page_the_dev_server_serves(\n    client, monkeypatch, tmp_path,\n):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"robotics-kickoff\", \"Meet us in room 204.\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"About us\", \"about-us\", \"We promote computer science.\")\n\n    site = _publish(monkeypatch, tmp_path)\n\n    index = json.loads((site / \"search-index.json\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    assert [item[\"title\"] for item in index] == [\"Robotics club kickoff\", \"About us\"]\n    assert index == client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json()\n    for name in (\"search.html\", \"search.js\"):\n        assert (site / name).read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\") == client.get(f\"/{name}\").text\n\n\n# -- Step 2: Drafts are absent from the index --\n\ndef test_step2_drafts_are_absent_from_the_index(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Live post\", \"live-post\", \"Public words.\")\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Secret draft post\", \"secret-post\", \"Hidden words.\", status=\"draft\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"Secret draft page\", \"secret-page\", \"Hidden words.\", status=\"draft\")\n    scheduled = _seed(\"post\", \"Secret scheduled post\", \"secret-scheduled\", \"Hidden words.\",\n                      status=\"draft\")\n    content_module.set_schedule(scheduled, \"post\", \"2099-01-01 00:00:00\")\n    unpublished = _seed(\"page\", \"Secret unpublished page\", \"secret-unpublished\", \"Hidden words.\")\n    content_module.set_status(unpublished, \"page\", \"draft\")\n\n    response = client.get(\"/search-index.json\")\n\n    assert [item[\"title\"] for item in response.json()] == [\"Live post\"]\n    assert \"secret\" not in response.text.lower() and \"hidden\" not in response.text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_step2_cms_publish_leaves_drafts_out_of_every_file(monkeypatch, tmp_path):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Live post\", \"live-post\", \"Public words.\")\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Secret draft post\", \"secret-post\", \"Hidden words.\", status=\"draft\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"Secret draft page\", \"secret-page\", \"Hidden words.\", status=\"draft\")\n\n    site = _publish(monkeypatch, tmp_path)\n\n    assert \"Live post\" in (site / \"search-index.json\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    for path in site.rglob(\"*\"):\n        if path.is_file():\n            text = path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").lower()\n            assert \"secret\" not in text and \"hidden\" not in text, path\n\n\n# -- Step 3: search.html loads one plain JavaScript file of 60 lines or fewer,\n#    with no external dependency and relative paths only --\n\ndef _is_relative(url: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"True for a URL that resolves against the page it is on: no scheme,\n    no host, and no leading slash.\"\"\"\n    parts = urlsplit(url)\n    return not (parts.scheme or parts.netloc or url.startswith((\"/\", \"\\\\\")))\n\n\ndef _scripts(html: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(attributes, inline code) of every <script> element in `html`.\"\"\"\n    return re.findall(r\"<script\\b([^>]*)>(.*?)</script\\s*>\", html, re.S | re.I)\n\n\ndef test_step3_search_html_loads_one_local_script_of_at_most_60_lines(client):\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\")\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n\n    [(attributes, inline)] = _scripts(page.text)\n    assert inline.strip() == \"\"\n    src = unescape(re.search(r'\\bsrc=\"([^\"]*)\"', attributes).group(1))\n    assert _is_relative(src), src\n    script = client.get(urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/search.html\", src)).path)\n    assert script.status_code == 200\n    assert \"javascript\" in script.headers[\"content-type\"]\n    assert len(script.text.splitlines()) <= 60\n\n\ndef test_step3_search_html_and_its_script_use_only_relative_urls(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"robotics-kickoff\", \"Meet us in room 204.\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"About us\", \"about-us\", \"We promote computer science.\")\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\").text\n\n    urls = [unescape(url) for url in re.findall(r'\\b(?:href|src)=\"([^\"]*)\"', page)]\n    assert urls and all(_is_relative(url) for url in urls), urls\n    [(attributes, _)] = _scripts(page)\n    src = unescape(re.search(r'\\bsrc=\"([^\"]*)\"', attributes).group(1))\n    script = client.get(urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/search.html\", src)).path).text\n    # No library pulled in, and no string the script could fetch from the root\n    # or another host (\"/search-index.json\" fails on a Pages subfolder).\n    assert not re.search(r\"\\b(import|require)\\s*\\(|\\bimport\\s\", script)\n    assert \"://\" not in script\n    assert not re.search(r\"\"\"[\"'`]/\"\"\", script), \"a string in the script starts with /\"\n    assert all(_is_relative(item[\"url\"]) for item in client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json())\n\n\n# A Page is exported to site/<slug>.html, so a Page with slug \"search\" would\n# overwrite site/search.html and its script with the Page's own text.\n\ndef test_step3_a_page_cannot_take_the_search_slug_and_replace_search_html(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = editor.post(\"/admin/pages/new\", data={\n        \"title\": \"Search\", \"slug\": \"search\", \"body_md\": \"x\",\n        \"csrf_token\": extract_csrf(editor.get(\"/admin/pages/new\").text),\n    })\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"reserved\" in response.text.lower()\n    assert content_module.list_content(\"page\") == []\n\n\ndef test_step3_an_older_page_with_the_search_slug_cannot_replace_search_html(client):\n    # Saved before \"search\" was reserved, which the editor no longer allows.\n    _seed(\"page\", \"Old search page\", \"search\", \"Saved before the slug was reserved.\")\n\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\").text\n\n    assert \"Old search page\" not in page and len(_scripts(page)) == 1\n    assert client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json() == []\n\n\n# -- Step 5: the published home page links to search.html with a relative path --\n\ndef test_step5_the_home_page_links_to_search_html_with_a_relative_path(client):\n    home = client.get(\"/index.html\").text\n\n    hrefs = [unescape(href) for href in re.findall(r'<a\\b[^>]*\\bhref=\"([^\"]*)\"', home)]\n    search_links = [href for href in hrefs\n                    if urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/index.html\", href)).path == \"/search.html\"]\n    assert search_links, hrefs\n    assert all(_is_relative(href) for href in search_links), search_links\n    assert client.get(\"/search.html\").status_code == 200\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":113,"oldLines":9,"newStart":113,"newLines":10,"lines":[" "," "," def test_step2_cms_publish_leaves_drafts_out_of_every_file(monkeypatch, tmp_path):","+    # Words Switching the draft markers to words no asset contains:"},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01VqkofETipT1x2fDuXsFSHc","name":"Edit","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\tests\\test_search.py","old_string":"def test_step2_cms_publish_leaves_drafts_out_of_every_file(monkeypatch, tmp_path):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Live post\", \"live-post\", \"Public words.\")\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Secret draft post\", \"secret-post\", \"Hidden words.\", status=\"draft\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"Secret draft page\", \"secret-page\", \"Hidden words.\", status=\"draft\")\n\n    site = _publish(monkeypatch, tmp_path)\n\n    assert \"Live post\" in (site / \"search-index.json\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    for path in site.rglob(\"*\"):\n        if path.is_file():\n            text = path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").lower()\n            assert \"secret\" not in text and \"hidden\" not in text, path","new_string":"def test_step2_cms_publish_leaves_drafts_out_of_every_file(monkeypatch, tmp_path):\n    # Words no template, stylesheet or script contains, unlike \"hidden\".\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Live post\", \"live-post\", \"Public words.\")\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Quetzal draft post\", \"quetzal-post\", \"Ocelot words.\", status=\"draft\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"Quetzal draft page\", \"quetzal-page\", \"Ocelot words.\", status=\"draft\")\n\n    site = _publish(monkeypatch, tmp_path)\n\n    assert \"Live post\" in (site / \"search-index.json\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    for path in site.rglob(\"*\"):\n        if path.is_file():\n            text = path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").lower()\n            assert \"quetzal\" not in text and \"ocelot\" not in text, path"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}

Search results show it under the title.\n_Avoid_: summary, snippet (a Snippet is the Media library's Markdown)\n","originalFile":"# CONTEXT.md glossary\n\nA small, WordPress-style web CMS: a local admin console where Editors and Admins manage content, and a static public site that publishes it. The content model is intentionally generic — built with no specific client in mind. A specific client site has been built *using* this CMS. The site was created for the Upper Arlington High School's Computer Science Honor Society chapter (UAHS CSHS), specifically for Dr. Diane Kahle (faculty advisor). The chapter needs a website to promote computer science among UAHS students.\n\n## Roles\n\n**Admin**:\nA CMS user role with full permissions: everything an Editor can do, plus publishing/unpublishing content and managing user accounts (create, change role, deactivate). When this CMS is introduced to the client for the UAHS CSHS chapter, Dr. Kahle will be given admin permissions.\n_Avoid_: superadmin, owner\n\n**Editor**:\nA CMS user role that can create, edit, and delete any Post or Page — including another user's drafts — but cannot publish/unpublish content or manage user accounts. Student officers will be given Editor permissions.\n_Avoid_: contributor, author (an Author is a content attribute, not a role)\n\n## Content\n\n**Post**:\nA dated, feed-like content item with a title, slug, Markdown body, draft/published status, author, and timestamps. Appears in the site's chronological feed.\n_Avoid_: article, entry\n\n**Page**:\nA static, evergreen content item — same fields and operations as a Post, plus appearing in the public site's navigation once published. The UAHS-CSHS website includes The Latest Posts, Coursework, Contact Us, About Us (mission + why join + eligibility + requirements + questions).\n_Avoid_: static page (redundant)\n\n**Slug**:\nThe URL-safe identifier for a Post or Page, unique within its kind, used to build its published path. \n\n**Status (Draft / Published)**:\nThe two states a Post or Page can be in. A Draft is visible only in the admin console; only a Published item reaches the static export.\n_Avoid_: live/unlive, active/inactive\n\n**Author**:\nThe user (Admin or Editor) recorded as having written a given Post or Page. Distinct from whoever most recently edited it.\n\n## Publishing\n\n**Publish** (verb):\nThe admin-only action that flips a content item's status from Draft to Published, making it eligible to appear in the next static export.\n_Avoid_: approve (there's no separate approval workflow — publish is a single, direct action)\n\n**Static export**:\nThe `site/` directory `cms publish` generates from currently-published content only; what `cms deploy` pushes to GitHub Pages. Every link in it is relative. A link written in a body from the site root (`/contact-us.html`) is rewritten relative to the file it lands in (`./contact-us.html`, or `../contact-us.html` from a Post), since GitHub Pages serves the site from a subfolder. The admin preview keeps it as written.\n\n**Revision**:\nOne saved version of a Post or Page: its title, slug, and body, who saved it, and when, numbered 1, 2, 3… within that item. Every create, edit, and Roll back records one; Publish and unpublish do not, since they change Status, not content.\n_Avoid_: snapshot, history entry\n\n**Revision history**:\nThe list of an item's Revisions, newest first, on its edit screen. The newest is the Current one.\n\n**Roll back** (verb):\nReturning an item's title, slug, and body to those of an earlier Revision. Editors and Admins can do it; it is itself recorded as a new Revision, so a Roll back can be undone the same way. Status is unchanged: a Published item's restored text reaches the site on the next static export.\n_Avoid_: restore, revert, undo\n\n**Scheduled publishing**:\nAn Admin setting a future time, in UTC, after which a Draft becomes Published. The public site is static, so nothing happens at that moment: the item becomes Published on the next `cms publish` after its time, which switches it before writing the static export. Setting or cancelling a schedule records no Revision, since it changes Status, not content.\n_Avoid_: auto-publish, publishing \"automatically\"\n\n**Scheduled**:\nA Draft with a publish time set. The dashboard and lists show it as \"scheduled\", apart from other Drafts. Publishing or unpublishing it by hand cancels its schedule.\n\n## Media\n\n**Media library**:\nThe admin screen where Editors and Admins upload images for Posts (PNG or JPEG, 2 MB or less) and copy each one's Snippet. The files live in `media/`, which is git-ignored like the database; `cms publish` copies all of `media/` into the Static export.\n_Avoid_: gallery, uploads\n\n**Alt text**:\nThe words that describe an image to someone who can't see it; a screen reader reads them aloud. Every upload needs it, and the Snippet carries it into the Post's `<img alt>`.\n_Avoid_: caption (a caption is shown to everyone)\n\n**Snippet**:\nThe Markdown the Media library shows for each image, `![<Alt text>](media/<file>)`, ready to paste into a Post's body. `media/` is read from the site root, so the Static export rewrites it relative to the file it lands in (`../media/<file>` from a Post), and the editor's preview does the same for its own page.\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":71,"oldLines":3,"newStart":71,"newLines":13,"lines":[" "," **Snippet**:"," The Markdown the Media library shows for each image, `![<Alt text>](media/<file>)`, ready to paste into a Post's body. `media/` is read from the site root, so the Static export rewrites it relative to the file it lands in (`../media/<file>` from a Post), and the editor's preview does the same for its own page.","+","+## Search","+","+**Search index**:","+The file `search-index.json` that `cms publish` writes into the Static export: the title, relative URL, and Excerpt of every Published Post and Page, and nothing from a Draft. The public site's search page (`search.html`) reads it in the reader's browser and lists every item whose title or Excerpt holds each typed word. There is no search server.","+_Avoid_: search database","+","+**Excerpt**:","+The start of a Post's or Page's body as plain text, 160 characters or fewer, cut at a word and ended with \"…\" when there is more. Search results show it under the title.","+_Avoid_: summary, snippet (a Snippet is the Media library's Markdown)"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"46d23354-b476-4454-949d-7930f204413c","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"46a8d74b-d860-4909-a43f-d4dbcfcc3476","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"28e2330c-52aa-4363-b1f2-19829f0a52ed","version":"2.1.305","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"f7a0042c-23d8-49eb-aecf-4006495b3750","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgEoUz2jfdqoPGADz3TNe","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01XR21TYbkv6MqXhyGKcU4dh","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Users\\rajan\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\claude\\C--Rajan-E-disk-My-work-IPHS400-code-mp2-cms\\28e2330c-52aa-4363-b1f2-19829f0a52ed\\scratchpad\\f5-findings-comment.md","content":"## /code-review findings and resolutions\n\nTwo-axis review (Standards, Spec) of the F5 diff on top of 5cf2937, run as two parallel sub-agents. Every fix below landed before the closing commit.\n\n### Standards\n\n| # | Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | Two reserved-slug tests were named `test_step3_…` without saying how they check step 3. | **Fixed.** Renamed to `test_step3_a_page_cannot_take_the_search_slug_and_replace_search_html` and `test_step3_an_older_page_with_the_search_slug_cannot_replace_search_html`. A comment above them says why: a Page exports to `site/<slug>.html`, so slug `search` would overwrite `search.html`. |\n| 2 | No test ran `cms publish`, so deleting the three new `_write(...)` lines left the suite green. `test_export`'s draft check only scans `*.html`, so it never read `search-index.json`. | **Fixed.** Added `test_step1_cms_publish_writes_the_index_and_search_page_the_dev_server_serves` (the export equals what the dev server serves) and `test_step2_cms_publish_leaves_drafts_out_of_every_file` (reads every file in `site/`). Mutations deleting each `_write` line now fail. |\n| 3 | `entry` is on Post's _Avoid_ list in CONTEXT.md; the repo's word is `item`. \"Search index\" and \"excerpt\" were new terms not in the glossary. | **Fixed.** `entry` → `item` in `search.js`, `search_index_json` and the tests. Added a Search section to CONTEXT.md defining **Search index** and **Excerpt**. |\n| 4 | Docstrings out of date: `app/routes/public.py` didn't list the new paths; `app/mdrender.py` said HTML only. | **Fixed** in both. |\n| 4b | ADR-001/ADR-002 don't mention the public site's first script. | **Not fixed, on purpose.** The manual places that ADR in P3 (\"if you also do P3, that exception makes a good ADR\"). P3 isn't in this plan. |\n| 5 | Possible Mysterious Name: `result()` builds an `<li>`; `show()` filters and renders. | **Fixed.** Now `resultRow()` and `showResults()`. |\n| 6 | Possible Shotgun Surgery (one root file = a write, a route and a reserved slug); possible Duplicated Code (`posts/{slug}.html` built in several places); possible Data Clumps (`css_path`/`home_path`/`nav_items`). | **Not fixed, on purpose.** All three are existing patterns in `app/publish.py` that this change follows. Folding them into a shared path helper would rewrite `home_html`, `nav_items` and `render_site` for no change in behaviour. |\n| 7 | **Bug:** `search.html` promised a match on \"a word in its title or text\", but only the title and the 160-character excerpt are searched. | **Fixed.** The text now reads \"a word from its title or its first few lines\". The index stays short, as step 1 asks. |\n\n### Spec\n\n| # | Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | Steps 1, 2 and 5 are \"Checked by: publish, test\", but no test called `render_site`. | **Fixed:** same as Standards 2. The reviewer had also run the export by hand: every file written, the Draft absent, every link relative. |\n| 2 | Scope beyond the table: the reserved `search` slug, matching the excerpt as well as the title, the result count, the load-failure message and `<noscript>`. | **Kept.** The reviewer judged all of them justified. The slug guard stops a Page from overwriting `site/search.html`. Drafts, including scheduled ones, are left out.\n  - `search.html`: the search page.\n  - `search.js`: its one script, 55 lines of plain JavaScript with no library. It loads the index with a relative `fetch(\"search-index.json\")` and builds the results without `innerHTML`, so a title can't inject HTML.\n- The home page has a relative \"Search posts and pages\" link.\n- `cms serve` serves the same three files at the same paths, so the link works in the local preview too.\n- `search` is now a reserved Page slug, alongside `index`. A Page called `search` would otherwise overwrite the search page. Your real `cms.db` has no such Page.\n- No schema change, no new setting, no new form, no new dependency, and no existing test was changed. One result came up and its link opened the post, at 1280 and 390, with no console errors. All 43 checks passed.\n- The two screenshots are saved: `docs/screenshots/mp2plus-search-1280.png` and `-390.png`.\n\n**Review**\n- Neither reviewer found a hard violation. One registry such as `ROOT_PAGES = {\\\"index\\\": home_html, \\\"search\\\": search_html}`, used by `render_site`, the router and `reserved_slug_reason`, removes that drift.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/publish.py\",\n    \"line\": 101,\n    \"summary\": \"`_excerpt` writes its own one-line cut-at-a-word logic; the standard library's `textwrap.shorten(text, EXCERPT_LENGTH, placeholder=\\\"…\\\")` already does this, keeps the result at 160 or fewer including the \\\"…\\\", and also collapses whitespace.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"`text[:EXCERPT_LENGTH + 1].rsplit(\\\" \\\", 1)[0][:EXCERPT_LENGTH].rstrip(...)` is hard to check (it produced the 161-character overrun and the excerpt that is only \\\"…\\\"). The dev route `/search-index.json` re-renders every body on each request.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"In `render_site`, `list_published(\\\"post\\\")` runs in `home_html`, `search_index_json` and the posts loop, and `_exportable_pages()` runs once per `nav_items` call plus the index and the loop. Fetching the lists once and passing them in would halve the Markdown and nh3 work and remove the repeated queries. Plain JavaScript, no library. Every URL is relative, because\n// GitHub Pages serves the site from a subfolder.\n(function () {\n  var input = document.getElementById(\"search-input\");\n  var status = document.getElementById(\"search-status\");\n  var results = document.getElementById(\"search-results\");\n  var index = null;\n\n  // Titles and excerpts are user content: build nodes with textContent,\n  // never innerHTML.\n  function resultRow(item) {\n    var link = document.createElement(\"a\");\n    link.className = \"post-card\";\n    link.href = item.url;\n    var title = document.createElement(\"span\");\n    title.className = \"post-card__title\";\n    title.textContent = item.title;\n    var excerpt = document.createElement(\"span\");\n    excerpt.className = \"post-card__excerpt\";\n    excerpt.textContent = item.excerpt;\n    link.append(title, excerpt);\n    var row = document.createElement(\"li\");\n    row.append(link);\n    return row;\n  }\n\n  function showResults() {\n    var words = input.value.toLowerCase().split(/\\s+/).filter(Boolean);\n    results.replaceChildren();\n    if (index === null || words.length === 0) {\n      status.textContent = \"\";\n      return;\n    }\n    var hits = index.filter(function (item) {\n      var text = (item.title + \" \" + item.excerpt).toLowerCase();\n      return words.every(function (word) { return text.indexOf(word) !== -1; });\n    });\n    results.append.apply(results, hits.map(resultRow));\n    status.textContent = hits.length === 1 ? Plain JavaScript, no library. Every URL is relative, because\n// GitHub Pages serves the site from a subfolder.\n(function () {\n  var input = document.getElementById(\"search-input\");\n  var status = document.getElementById(\"search-status\");\n  var results = document.getElementById(\"search-results\");\n  var index = null;  // the index's items, once it has loaded\n  var failed = false;\n\n  // Titles and excerpts are user content: build nodes with textContent,\n  // never innerHTML.\n  function resultRow(item) {\n    var link = document.createElement(\"a\");\n    link.className = \"post-card\";\n    link.href = item.url;\n    var title = document.createElement(\"span\");\n    title.className = \"post-card__title\";\n    title.textContent = item.title;\n    var excerpt = document.createElement(\"span\");\n    excerpt.className = \"post-card__excerpt\";\n    excerpt.textContent = item.excerpt;\n    link.append(title, excerpt);\n    var row = document.createElement(\"li\");\n    row.append(link);\n    return row;\n  }\n\n  function showResults() {\n    if (failed) { return; }  // keep the \"unavailable\" message up\n    var words = input.value.toLowerCase().split(/\\s+/).filter(Boolean);\n    results.replaceChildren();\n    status.textContent = words.length && index === null ? \"Loading the search index…\" : \"\";\n    if (index === null) { return; }\n    // Keep the words in the address (search.html?q=…), so Back from a\n    // result returns to the same list.\n    history.replaceState(null, \"\", words.length ? \"?q=\" + encodeURIComponent(input.value) : \"search.html\");\n    if (words.length === 0) { return; }\n    var hits = index.filter(function (item) {\n      var text = (item.title + \" \" + item.excerpt).toLowerCase();\n      return words.every(function (word) { return text.indexOf(word) !== -1; });\n    });\n    results.append.apply(results, hits.map(resultRow));\n    status.textContent = hits.length === 1 ? \"1 result\" :\n      hits.length === 0 ? \"No results\" : hits.length + \" results\";\n  }\n\n  input.value = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get(\"q\") || \"\";\n  input.addEventListener(\"input\", showResults);\n  fetch(\"search-index.json\")\n    .then(function (response) {\n      if (!response.ok) { throw new Error(\"search index \" + response.status); }\n      return response.json();\n    })\n    .then(function (items) { index = items; showResults(); })\n    .catch(function () {\n      failed = true;\n      status.textContent = \"Search is unavailable: the search index didn't load.\";\n    });\n})();\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01VZgecybaariCdgqVqEuuN2","name":"Edit","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\templates\\public\\search.html","old_string":"    <input id=\"search-input\" type=\"search\" autocomplete=\"off\" spellcheck=\"false\">","new_string":"    <input id=\"search-input\" type=\"search\" spellcheck=\"false\">"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01AWX8rk8u7EHg7oQm9DHgc2","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cd \"/c/Rajan/E disk/My work/IPHS400/code/mp2-cms\" && wc -l app/search.js","description":"Count script lines after the fix"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}
