The dev server\nserves the same files at the same paths, through the same app.publish code,\nso most tests read them over HTTP; two run `cms publish` itself. Each test is\nnamed after the acceptance step on #22 it checks.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport re\nfrom html import unescape\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit\n\nfrom app import cli, settings\nfrom app import content as content_module\nfrom app import db as db_module\nfrom tests.conftest import extract_csrf\n\nBASE = \"http://testserver\"\n\n\ndef _admin_id() -> int:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'admin@example.test'\"\n        ).fetchone()[\"id\"]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef _seed(kind: str, title: str, slug: str, body_md: str, status: str = \"published\") -> int:\n    content_id = content_module.create_content(kind, title, slug, body_md, _admin_id())\n    if status == \"published\":\n        content_module.set_status(content_id, kind, \"published\")\n    return content_id\n\n\n# -- Step 1: the index has the title, relative URL and a short excerpt of each\n#    published Post and Page --\n\ndef test_step1_the_index_lists_each_published_post_and_page(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"robotics-kickoff\", \"Meet us in room 204.\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"About us\", \"about-us\", \"We promote computer science.\")\n\n    response = client.get(\"/search-index.json\")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"application/json\")\n    assert response.json() == [\n        {\"title\": \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"url\": \"posts/robotics-kickoff.html\",\n         \"excerpt\": \"Meet us in room 204.\"},\n        {\"title\": \"About us\", \"url\": \"about-us.html\",\n         \"excerpt\": \"We promote computer science.\"},\n    ]\n\n\ndef test_step1_the_excerpt_is_short_plain_text(client):\n    body = (\"# Welcome\\n\\nJoin **CS Honor Society** & meet [our officers](/about-us.html).\"\n            \"\\n\\n<script>alert(1)</script>\\n\\n\" + \"lorem \" * 80)\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Welcome\", \"welcome\", body)\n\n    excerpt = client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json()[0][\"excerpt\"]\n\n    assert excerpt.startswith(\"Welcome Join CS Honor Society & meet our officers. lorem lorem\")\n    assert \"<\" not in excerpt and \"alert\" not in excerpt and \"&amp;\" not in excerpt\n    assert len(excerpt) <= 161 and excerpt.endswith(\"lorem…\"), excerpt\n\n\ndef _publish(monkeypatch, tmp_path) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Run `cms publish` into a temporary site/ and return it.\"\"\"\n    site = tmp_path / \"site\"\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"SITE\", site)\n    assert cli.main([\"publish\"]) == 0\n    return site\n\n\ndef test_step1_cms_publish_writes_the_index_and_search_page_the_dev_server_serves(\n    client, monkeypatch, tmp_path,\n):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"robotics-kickoff\", \"Meet us in room 204.\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"About us\", \"about-us\", \"We promote computer science.\")\n\n    site = _publish(monkeypatch, tmp_path)\n\n    index = json.loads((site / \"search-index.json\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    assert [item[\"title\"] for item in index] == [\"Robotics club kickoff\", \"About us\"]\n    assert index == client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json()\n    for name in (\"search.html\", \"search.js\"):\n        assert (site / name).read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\") == client.get(f\"/{name}\").text\n\n\n# -- Step 2: Drafts are absent from the index --\n\ndef test_step2_drafts_are_absent_from_the_index(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Live post\", \"live-post\", \"Public words.\")\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Secret draft post\", \"secret-post\", \"Hidden words.\", status=\"draft\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"Secret draft page\", \"secret-page\", \"Hidden words.\", status=\"draft\")\n    scheduled = _seed(\"post\", \"Secret scheduled post\", \"secret-scheduled\", \"Hidden words.\",\n                      status=\"draft\")\n    content_module.set_schedule(scheduled, \"post\", \"2099-01-01 00:00:00\")\n    unpublished = _seed(\"page\", \"Secret unpublished page\", \"secret-unpublished\", \"Hidden words.\")\n    content_module.set_status(unpublished, \"page\", \"draft\")\n\n    response = client.get(\"/search-index.json\")\n\n    assert [item[\"title\"] for item in response.json()] == [\"Live post\"]\n    assert \"secret\" not in response.text.lower() and \"hidden\" not in response.text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_step2_cms_publish_leaves_drafts_out_of_every_file(monkeypatch, tmp_path):\n    # Words no template, stylesheet or script contains, unlike \"hidden\".\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Live post\", \"live-post\", \"Public words.\")\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Quetzal draft post\", \"quetzal-post\", \"Ocelot words.\", status=\"draft\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"Quetzal draft page\", \"quetzal-page\", \"Ocelot words.\", status=\"draft\")\n\n    site = _publish(monkeypatch, tmp_path)\n\n    assert \"Live post\" in (site / \"search-index.json\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    for path in site.rglob(\"*\"):\n        if path.is_file():\n            text = path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").lower()\n            assert \"quetzal\" not in text and \"ocelot\" not in text, path\n\n\n# -- Step 3: search.html loads one plain JavaScript file of 60 lines or fewer,\n#    with no external dependency and relative paths only --\n\ndef _is_relative(url: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"True for a URL that resolves against the page it is on: no scheme,\n    no host, and no leading slash.\"\"\"\n    parts = urlsplit(url)\n    return not (parts.scheme or parts.netloc or url.startswith((\"/\", \"\\\\\")))\n\n\ndef _scripts(html: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(attributes, inline code) of every <script> element in `html`.\"\"\"\n    return re.findall(r\"<script\\b([^>]*)>(.*?)</script\\s*>\", html, re.S | re.I)\n\n\ndef test_step3_search_html_loads_one_local_script_of_at_most_60_lines(client):\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\")\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n\n    [(attributes, inline)] = _scripts(page.text)\n    assert inline.strip() == \"\"\n    src = unescape(re.search(r'\\bsrc=\"([^\"]*)\"', attributes).group(1))\n    assert _is_relative(src), src\n    script = client.get(urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/search.html\", src)).path)\n    assert script.status_code == 200\n    assert \"javascript\" in script.headers[\"content-type\"]\n    assert len(script.text.splitlines()) <= 60\n\n\ndef test_step3_search_html_and_its_script_use_only_relative_urls(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"robotics-kickoff\", \"Meet us in room 204.\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"About us\", \"about-us\", \"We promote computer science.\")\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\").text\n\n    urls = [unescape(url) for url in re.findall(r'\\b(?:href|src)=\"([^\"]*)\"', page)]\n    assert urls and all(_is_relative(url) for url in urls), urls\n    [(attributes, _)] = _scripts(page)\n    src = unescape(re.search(r'\\bsrc=\"([^\"]*)\"', attributes).group(1))\n    script = client.get(urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/search.html\", src)).path).text\n    # No library pulled in, and no string the script could fetch from the root\n    # or another host (\"/search-index.json\" fails on a Pages subfolder).\n    assert not re.search(r\"\\b(import|require)\\s*\\(|\\bimport\\s\", script)\n    assert \"://\" not in script\n    assert not re.search(r\"\"\"[\"'`]/\"\"\", script), \"a string in the script starts with /\"\n    assert all(_is_relative(item[\"url\"]) for item in client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json())\n\n\n# A Page is exported to site/<slug>.html, so a Page with slug \"search\" would\n# overwrite site/search.html and its script with the Page's own text.\n\ndef test_step3_a_page_cannot_take_the_search_slug_and_replace_search_html(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = editor.post(\"/admin/pages/new\", data={\n        \"title\": \"Search\", \"slug\": \"search\", \"body_md\": \"x\",\n        \"csrf_token\": extract_csrf(editor.get(\"/admin/pages/new\").text),\n    })\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"reserved\" in response.text.lower()\n    assert content_module.list_content(\"page\") == []\n\n\ndef test_step3_an_older_page_with_the_search_slug_cannot_replace_search_html(client):\n    # Saved before \"search\" was reserved, which the editor no longer allows.\n    _seed(\"page\", \"Old search page\", \"search\", \"Saved before the slug was reserved.\")\n\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\").text\n\n    assert \"Old search page\" not in page and len(_scripts(page)) == 1\n    assert client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json() == []\n\n\n# -- Step 5: the published home page links to search.html with a relative path --\n\ndef test_step5_the_home_page_links_to_search_html_with_a_relative_path(client):\n    home = client.get(\"/index.html\").text\n\n    hrefs = [unescape(href) for href in re.findall(r'<a\\b[^>]*\\bhref=\"([^\"]*)\"', home)]\n    search_links = [href for href in hrefs\n                    if urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/index.html\", href)).path == \"/search.html\"]\n    assert search_links, hrefs\n    assert all(_is_relative(href) for href in search_links), search_links\n    assert client.get(\"/search.html\").status_code == The cut falls at a word\n    break, unless the text has none to fall at.\"\"\"\n    text = render_text(body_md)\n    if len(text) <= EXCERPT_LENGTH:\n        return text\n    head = text[:EXCERPT_LENGTH]\n    cut = head.rsplit(\" \", 1)[0] if \" \" in head else head[:-1]\n    return (cut.rstrip(\" .,;:\") or cut) + \"…\"","originalFile":"\"\"\"Render the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nT00 publishes a placeholder home page. As you build content types, extend\nrender_site() to write one file per published item. Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n     That includes links written in a body: render_markdown(..., to_root=...)\n     rewrites \"/contact-us.html\" and \"media/logo.png\" for the file it lands in.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import content as content_module\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.mdrender import render_markdown, render_text\n\n# One stylesheet for the public site and the admin console (served at /style.css).\nCSS = Path(__file__).with_name(\"style.css\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n# search.html's one script, which searches site/search-index.json.\nSEARCH_JS = Path(__file__).with_name(\"search.js\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n# The most characters of a body that search.html shows under a result's title.\nEXCERPT_LENGTH = 160\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef nav_items(prefix: str = \"\") -> list[dict[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"Published Pages, as relative (title, href) links for the public\n    site's nav. `prefix` relocates the link for a page nested one\n    directory deep (e.g. \"../\" from site/posts/*.html) — a draft Page\n    never appears here.\"\"\"\n    return [{\"title\": page[\"title\"], \"href\": f\"{prefix}{page['slug']}.html\"}\n            for page in _exportable_pages()]\n\n\ndef _exportable_pages() -> list:\n    # The editor already refuses reserved slugs; this also covers rows saved\n    # before that check existed, so a Page can never overwrite site/index.html.\n    return [page for page in content_module.list_published(\"page\")\n            if not content_module.reserved_slug_reason(\"page\", page[\"slug\"])]\n\n\ndef _date(item) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The calendar day an item was created, e.g. \"2026-10-07\".\"\"\"\n    return item[\"created_at\"][:10]\n\n\ndef home_html() -> str:\n    \"\"\"The home page (feed of published Posts), as written to site/index.html.\"\"\"\n    posts = content_module.list_published(\"post\")\n    return environment().get_template(\"public/home.html\").render(\n        title=settings.SITE_TITLE, items=[\n            {\"title\": post[\"title\"], \"href\": f\"posts/{post['slug']}.html\",\n             \"date\": _date(post)} for post in posts\n        ],\n        css_path=\"style.css\", home_path=\"index.html\", nav_items=nav_items(),\n    )\n\n\ndef search_html() -> str:\n    \"\"\"The search page, as written to site/search.html; its script is\n    site/search.js.\"\"\"\n    return environment().get_template(\"public/search.html\").render(\n        title=\"Search\", site_title=settings.SITE_TITLE,\n        css_path=\"style.css\", home_path=\"index.html\", nav_items=nav_items(),\n    )\n\n\ndef search_index_json() -> str:\n    \"\"\"site/search-index.json: the title, URL and a plain-text excerpt of\n    every published Post and Page, for search.html's script to search. Each\n    URL is relative to the site root, where search.html is.\"\"\"\n    items = [(post, f\"posts/{post['slug']}.html\")\n             for post in content_module.list_published(\"post\")]\n    items += [(page, f\"{page['slug']}.html\") for page in _exportable_pages()]\n    return json.dumps([\n        {\"title\": item[\"title\"], \"url\": url, \"excerpt\": _excerpt(item[\"body_md\"])}\n        for item, url in items\n    ], ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)\n\n\ndef _excerpt(body_md: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The start of a body as plain text, cut at a word break to\n    EXCERPT_LENGTH characters or fewer, then \"…\" if anything was cut.\"\"\"\n    text = render_text(body_md)\n    if len(text) <= EXCERPT_LENGTH:\n        return text\n    return text[:EXCERPT_LENGTH + 1].rsplit(\" \", 1)[0][:EXCERPT_LENGTH].rstrip(\" .,;:\") + \"…\"\n\n\ndef post_html(post) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A published Post, as written to site/posts/<slug>.html — one directory\n    deep, so every shared link climbs a level.\"\"\"\n    return _detail_html(\"public/post.html\", \"post\", post, prefix=\"../\")\n\n\ndef page_html(page) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A published Page, as written to site/<slug>.html.\"\"\"\n    return _detail_html(\"public/page.html\", \"page\", page, prefix=\"\")\n\n\ndef _detail_html(template_name: str, item_key: str, item, *, prefix: str) -> str:\n    return environment().get_template(template_name).render(\n        title=item[\"title\"], site_title=settings.SITE_TITLE,\n        **{item_key: item}, date=_date(item),\n        body_html=render_markdown(item[\"body_md\"], to_root=prefix),\n        css_path=f\"{prefix}style.css\", home_path=f\"{prefix}index.html\",\n        nav_items=nav_items(prefix=prefix),\n    )\n\n\ndef _write(path: Path, text: str) -> None:\n    # Explicit UTF-8: the pages declare <meta charset=\"utf-8\">, and the\n    # platform default (cp1252 on Windows) can't encode an emoji at all.\n    path.write_text(text, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    _write(out / \"style.css\", CSS)\n    _write(out / \"index.html\", home_html())\n    _write(out / \"search.html\", search_html())\n    _write(out / \"search.js\", SEARCH_JS)\n    _write(out / \"search-index.json\", search_index_json())\n\n    posts_dir = out / \"posts\"\n    posts_dir.mkdir()\n    for post in content_module.list_published(\"post\"):\n        _write(posts_dir / f\"{post['slug']}.html\", post_html(post))\n    for page in _exportable_pages():\n        _write(out / f\"{page['slug']}.html\", page_html(page))\n\n    # Every file in media/ is meant to be public; Posts show them through\n    # their Media library snippets.\n    if settings.MEDIA.is_dir():\n        shutil.copytree(settings.MEDIA, out / \"media\")\n\n    return out\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":93,"oldLines":12,"newStart":93,"newLines":15,"lines":[" "," "," def _excerpt(body_md: str) -> str:","-    \"\"\"The start of a body as plain text, cut at a word break to","-    EXCERPT_LENGTH characters or fewer, then \"…\" if anything was cut.\"\"\"","+    \"\"\"The start of a body as plain text, EXCERPT_LENGTH characters or fewer","+    with the \"…\" that ends it when anything was cut. The cut falls at a word","+    break, unless the text has none to fall at.\"\"\"","     text = render_text(body_md)","     if len(text) <= EXCERPT_LENGTH:","         return text","-    return text[:EXCERPT_LENGTH + 1].rsplit(\" \", 1)[0][:EXCERPT_LENGTH].rstrip(\" .,;:\") + \"…\"","+    head = text[:EXCERPT_LENGTH]","+    cut = head.rsplit(\" \", 1)[0] if \" \" in head else head[:-1]","+    return (cut.rstrip(\" .,;:\") or cut) + \"…\""," "," "," def post_html(post) -> str:"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"db7094e0-d660-4eca-9646-cebe550246df","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"46a8d74b-d860-4909-a43f-d4dbcfcc3476","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"28e2330c-52aa-4363-b1f2-19829f0a52ed","version":"2.1.305","gitBranch":"main"}

(file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"fe3bb68f-2cc3-4de3-b086-1600cddd3faf","timestamp":"2026-10-21T05:25:35.292Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\app\\mdrender.py","oldString":"def render_text(raw: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The words of `raw` as a reader sees them on the page, with no markup:\n    every tag dropped (a <script> or <style> with its contents), entities\n    decoded, and whitespace runs collapsed to one space.\"\"\"\n    text = nh3.clean(_md.render(raw), tags=set())\n    return \" \".join(unescape(text).split())","newString":"def render_text(raw: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The words of `raw` as a reader sees them on the page, with no markup:\n    every tag dropped (a <script> or <style> with its contents), entities\n    decoded, and whitespace runs collapsed to one space.\n\n    The result is plain text, not HTML: a body that shows `<img ...>` as code\n    gives those characters back. Show it with textContent or escape it.\"\"\"\n    html = _LINE_ENDING_TAG.sub(lambda tag: \" \" + tag.group(0), _md.render(raw))\n    text = nh3.clean(html, tags=set())\n    return \" \".join(unescape(text).split())","originalFile":"\"\"\"Markdown -> sanitized HTML: the one pipeline the admin preview and the\nlater static export (T07) both reuse, so a post can't render one way in the\neditor and another way once published. The one deliberate difference is a\nlink to the site root, which the export makes relative (`to_root` below).\nBoth make a Media library image (`media/<file>`) relative to the page it is\nshown on. `render_text` reads the same Markdown as plain text, for the\nsearch index's excerpts.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom html import unescape\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\n\n_md = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\")\n\n# What a browser ignores before it reads a URL (WHATWG URL parsing): spaces\n# and control characters at either end, and tabs and newlines anywhere.\n_TRIMMED = \"\".join(chr(code) for code in range(0x21))\n_DROPPED = {ord(\"\\t\"): None, ord(\"\\n\"): None, ord(\"\\r\"): None}\n\n\ndef render_markdown(\n    raw: str, *, to_root: str | None = None, media_root: str | None = None,\n) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render Markdown to HTML, then strip anything unsafe (script tags,\n    event-handler attributes like onerror=, javascript: URLs, ...).\n\n    `to_root` is set when the HTML is written into site/: the \"../\" steps\n    from that file back to the site root (\"\" for a Page, \"../\" for a Post).\n    A link written in a body from the site root (`/contact-us.html`), and a\n    library snippet's image (`media/team.png`), are then made relative to the\n    file, because GitHub Pages serves the site from a subfolder.\n\n    Unset (the admin preview), links stay as written: the admin server\n    serves the public pages at its own root, so they resolve there. Only a\n    `media/` URL is rewritten, by `media_root`: the \"../\" steps from the admin\n    page the preview is shown on back to the server root, which serves media/.\n    \"\"\"\n    html = _md.render(raw)\n    if to_root is not None:\n        return nh3.clean(html, attribute_filter=_link_rewriter(to_root, root_links=True))\n    if media_root is not None:\n        return nh3.clean(html, attribute_filter=_link_rewriter(media_root, root_links=False))\n    return nh3.clean(html)\n\n\ndef render_text(raw: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The words of `raw` as a reader sees them on the page, with no markup:\n    every tag dropped (a <script> or <style> with its contents), entities\n    decoded, and whitespace runs collapsed to one space.\"\"\"\n    text = nh3.clean(_md.render(raw), tags=set())\n    return \" \".join(unescape(text).split())\n\n\ndef _link_rewriter(to_root: str, *, root_links: bool) -> Callable[[str, str, str], str]:\n    \"\"\"An nh3 attribute filter that makes every href/src starting `media/`\n    relative to the page, and, with `root_links`, every one a browser would\n    read as root-absolute or protocol-relative too.\n\n    nh3 checks URL schemes before it calls the filter, never after, so a\n    rewritten value must never be able to start a scheme: it always begins\n    with \"./\", \"../\" or \"https://\". Dropping only the \"/\" would turn\n    \"/javascript:alert(1)\" into a live javascript: link.\n    \"\"\"\n    prefix = to_root or \"./\"\n\n    def rewrite(tag: str, attribute: str, value: str) -> str:\n        if attribute not in (\"href\", \"src\"):\n            return value\n        url = value.strip(_TRIMMED).translate(_DROPPED).replace(\"\\\\\", \"/\")\n        if url.startswith(\"media/\"):\n            return prefix + url  # a Media library snippet names it from the site root\n        if not root_links:\n            return value\n        if url.startswith(\"//\"):\n            return \"https:\" + url  # protocol-relative; GitHub Pages is HTTPS-only\n        if url.startswith(\"/\"):\n            rest = url[1:]\n            if rest == \"\" or rest[0] in \"#?\":\n                rest = \"index.html\" + rest  # \"/\" is the home page\n            return prefix + rest\n        return value\n\n    return rewrite\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":50,"oldLines":8,"newStart":50,"newLines":12,"lines":[" def render_text(raw: str) -> str:","     \"\"\"The words of `raw` as a reader sees them on the page, with no markup:","     every tag dropped (a <script> or <style> with its contents), entities","-    decoded, and whitespace runs collapsed to one space.\"\"\"","-    text = nh3.clean(_md.render(raw), tags=set())","+    decoded, and whitespace runs collapsed to one space.","+","+    The result is plain text, not HTML: a body that shows `<img ...>` as code","+    gives those characters back. Only a\n    `media/` URL is rewritten, by `media_root`: the \"../\" steps from the admin\n    page the preview is shown on back to the server root, which serves media/.\n    \"\"\"\n    html = _md.render(raw)\n    if to_root is not None:\n        return nh3.clean(html, attribute_filter=_link_rewriter(to_root, root_links=True))\n    if media_root is not None:\n        return nh3.clean(html, attribute_filter=_link_rewriter(media_root, root_links=False))\n    return nh3.clean(html)\n\n\ndef render_text(raw: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The words of `raw` as a reader sees them on the page, with no markup:\n    every tag dropped (a <script> or <style> with its contents), entities\n    decoded, and whitespace runs collapsed to one space.\n\n    The result is plain text, not HTML: a body that shows `<img ...>` as code\n    gives those characters back. Bring a laptop & \"\n    \"[read the rules](/about.html) first.\\n\\n\" + \"We will build line-following robots. \" * 12)\nadd(\"post\", \"Hour of Code volunteers needed\", \"hour-of-code\",\n    \"Help us teach younger students to code during <em>Computer Science</em> Education Week.\")\nadd(\"post\", \"Secret officer elections draft\", \"officer-elections\",\n    \"Not ready yet: robotics {"parentUuid":"b41780cf-eb29-42e3-9cd6-f9903bea99eb","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgEqG3vX1Qe9ySNRvoCwc","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01ERHMgjdKQhpftKtR9pke4u","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Users\\rajan\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\claude\\C--Rajan-E-disk-My-work-IPHS400-code-mp2-cms\\28e2330c-52aa-4363-b1f2-19829f0a52ed\\scratchpad\\f5-findings-comment-round2.md","content":"## /code-review round 2: findings and resolutions\n\nA second, independent `/code-review` of the whole F5 diff, after the round-1 fixes above. It ran the suite and drove a browser through step 4 on the dev server and on an export served from a `/repo/` subfolder, the way Pages serves it. Search worked in both. It reported 15 findings.\n\n### Fixed\n\n| # | Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | **Bug:** `search.js` cleared the \"Search is unavailable\" message at the reader's first keystroke. Typing before the index loaded showed nothing. | A `failed` flag keeps the message up. While the index loads, the status reads \"Loading the search index…\". The walk now checks both: a forced 404, and a delayed index. |\n| 2 | **Bug:** Back from a result came back to an empty search in browsers that reload the page. | The words are kept in the address (`search.html?q=…`, relative, via `history.replaceState`), and the script reads `?q=` on load. `autocomplete=\"off\"` is gone. Walk checks added: Back restores the words and the result, a `?q=` link opens with its results, and clearing the box drops `?q=`. |\n| 3 | `_excerpt` could return 161 characters, but CONTEXT.md says 160 or fewer. A body of only punctuation gave an excerpt of just \"…\". | The cut now leaves room for the \"…\". If trimming punctuation would leave nothing, the cut is kept as it was. New test `test_step1_a_long_excerpt_is_160_characters_or_fewer_with_an_ellipsis` covers words, one long word, punctuation, and text with no spaces. The round-1 test's limit is now 160. |\n| 4 | `render_text` ran words together across raw-HTML blocks: `<div>alpha</div><div>beta</div>` → \"alphabeta\". The same happened across table cells and `<br>`. | It now puts a space before each line-ending tag. New test `test_step1_the_excerpt_keeps_words_from_separate_blocks_apart`. |\n| 5 | The older-`search`-Page test checked only the dev server. There, route order makes it pass even without the reserved-slug filter. | It now also runs `cms publish` and checks that the exported `search.html` is still the search page. A mutation that drops the filter from `_exportable_pages` now fails. |\n| 6 | `render_text` returns decoded text, so a body that shows `<img …>` as code comes back with those characters. That is safe only because the script uses `textContent`. | Its docstring now says the result is plain text, not HTML, and must be shown with `textContent` or escaped. |\n| 7 | The untracked `search.js`, `search.html` and `test_search.py` must go in the same commit as `publish.py`, which reads `search.js` at import. | Noted for the commit: all are staged together. |\n\n### Not fixed, on purpose\n\n| # | Finding | Why |\n|---|---|---|\n| 8 | Only the title and the first 160 characters are searched. | Step 1 asks for \"a short excerpt\" in the index, and step 4 for \"a word from a published post's title\". Since round 1 the page says \"its title or its first few lines\", which matches what the code does. |\n| 9 | The search index and the item files are built from separate queries in one `cms publish`, so an edit made during a publish could make them disagree. | `home_html` and the item loops already work this way. The admin console is local, and a publish takes about a second. |\n| 10 | No automated browser test for step 4, and `/search.html` isn't in `test_phone_width.py`'s list. | Step 4 is \"Checked by: walk\". The scripted walk covers it at 1280 and 390 and adds the checks above: 65/65. |\n| 11–15 | One registry for root files; `textwrap.shorten`; a path helper; querying once per publish; shared `_seed` helpers. | Same as round 1's smells: these are existing patterns, and folding them up would rewrite unrelated code. `textwrap.shorten` returns only \"…\" for one long word, which the new test rules out. |\n\n**Process note:** the review's browser check briefly wrote two rows (ids 13 and 14) into the developer's local `cms.db`. The reviewer removed them and reset the ID counters. That database was checked afterwards: the same 7 items, 25 revisions and 2 users as before, integrity ok. `media/` and `site/` were untouched.\n\n### Verification\n\n- `tests/test_search.py`: 15 tests. Full suite: 367 passed. `check_submission.py --stage 2`: 22/22.\n- Mutation pass: 24 of 24 mutations caught.\n- Walk: 65/65, at 1280 and 390, on the dev server and on `file://`. `search.js` is 59 lines.\n- Screenshots retaken from the final code.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":573,"cache_read_input_tokens":218772,"output_tokens":2079,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":272},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":573,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":2079,"cache_read_input_tokens":218772,"cache_creation_input_tokens":573,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":573},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01ERHMgjdKQhpftKtR9pke4u":{"file_path":"C:\\Users\\rajan\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\claude\\C--Rajan-E-disk-My-work-IPHS400-code-mp2-cms\\28e2330c-52aa-4363-b1f2-19829f0a52ed\\scratchpad\\f5-findings-comment-round2.md","content":"## /code-review round 2: findings and resolutions\n\nA second, independent `/code-review` of the whole F5 diff, after the round-1 fixes above. Warn about this before a review that drives a browser.\n- Next: F8 via P1.","originalFile":"---\nname: mp2plus\ndescription: \"MP2plus extra credit (Oct 20-21 2026): deadline, the user's plan, the F4 conflict with T16, and codebase facts for F1/F5/F8\"\nmetadata:\n  node_type: memory\n  type: project\n  originSessionId: 41d3c5ec-9a99-4c58-b059-23df9d8fecfb\n  modified: 2026-10-21T05:07:32.106Z\n---\n\n**Deadline:** due Tue 2026-10-20 2:40pm EDT (passed); no-penalty grace until **Wed 2026-10-21 2:40pm EDT**. Submit = tag `mp2plus-final` pushed + email `IPHS400 MP2plus - Rajan Thakur` (repo URL, Pages URL, tag, report attached). Manual and rubric live only on `template/main` (0a9eee4): `docs/manual_iphs400_mp2plus-web-cms_20261012.md`, `docs/mp2plus-grading-rubric_20261012.md`.\n\n**State on 2026-10-20 ~8:20pm EDT:** `mp2plus-base` = `mp2-final` = 42f91f7, both pushed. Plan committed as 8ddb990 (`mp2plus: plan`): F1, F4, F5, F8. Base results: checker 22/22, 286 tests. Phase file says `revise`.\n\n**Decided 2026-10-20:** F4 dropped. Order is **F1 → F5 → F8 (carried by P1: branch `mp2plus-theme` + PR) → S1**, worth 9+7+7+6+6 = 35 raw, capped at 30. The user edited the plan to match and is recommitting it themselves. F1: `cms publish` copies **every** file in `media/` (the user's call: anything in `media/` is meant to be public), and the admin serves `/media/` to logged-in users so library thumbnails and the editor's preview work. P1: findings go on the PR, plus a one-line link on the issue.\n\n**F1 closed 2026-10-21 03:57Z:** the user committed and pushed `5cf2937` on top of `c755c3f`; #21 is closed with both findings comments above the close. Next is F5; the handoff is `%TEMP%\\mp2plus-handoff-05_f5-search_20261021.md`. Earlier history: issue #21, commit c755c3f. Findings comment is posted on #21. 343 tests pass (57 in `tests/test_media.py`), checker 22/22, screenshots committed. `tests/conftest.py` gained 2 lines (`settings.MEDIA` → tmp). The Alt text rule is a round trip through `render_markdown`, not a character list. A second /code-review round left 3 fixes **uncommitted** (invisible-only alt text, the backslash named in the message, partial-file cleanup; 352 tests). The round-2 findings comment is posted on #21. The user said \"Just don't do commits\": they commit and push themselves. Their `/code-review` prompt said #14/T14 by mistake (copied from the manual's example); it is #21. Still the user's to do: commit, push, the report row. Next issue number: #22.\n\n**F5 built 2026-10-21 ~01:10 EDT, uncommitted:** issue #22, phase `T22`. 362 tests pass (10 in `tests/test_search.py`); checker 22/22; 20/20 mutations killed; walk 43/43; both screenshots saved. The user picked the **dev-server HTTP seam only**, then OK'd two `cms publish` tests after review. The findings comment is drafted in the session scratchpad, **not yet posted**: post it only after the user OKs. The user commits and pushes. `search` is now in `RESERVED_SLUGS`. The new glossary terms are Search index and Excerpt. Next: F8 via P1.\n\n**S1 snag:** admin-only routes depend on wrapper closures (`_require_admin_to_publish`, `_require_admin_to_schedule` in `content_crud.py`, `_require_admin_for_users` in `users.py`) that call `require_admin` inside, so a router walk can't see `require_admin`. S1 needs a marker on those dependencies.\n\n**F4 conflict (flagged to the user):** T16 (#18) already shipped scheduled publishing, so F4 scores 0 (\"a feature already present at mp2plus-base is not scored again\"). F4's spec also clashes with T16's tests (`test_editors_see_no_schedule_controls`, the flip to Published in `test_scheduling.py`), and changing base test assertions fails the gate, which zeroes every exercise.\n\n**Rules that bite:** issue first (label `stretch`, body = acceptance table verbatim + `Blocked by: none`); phase `T<issue#>` set before the session; commit `T<issue#>: … Closes #<issue#>`; findings comment before close; tests in `tests/test_{slug}.py` named `test_step<k>_…`; screenshots `docs/screenshots/mp2plus-{slug}-{1280,390}.png`; base test files may only gain cases. Issues and PRs share numbering. `/mattpocock-skills:implement` works when invoked by name, even though the skill list doesn't show it.\n\n**Codebase facts:** one stylesheet `app/style.css` serves both the admin (`/style.css` route in `app/routes/public.py`) and the export (`CSS` constant read at import in `app/publish.py`). Body-link rewriting is `_link_rewriter` in `app/mdrender.py` (also rewrites `media/` URLs; `media_root` for the admin preview) (prefix never empty: XSS lesson from T17). {"parentUuid":"8d1b537f-4cb7-48f6-910e-b850318e00f4","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgErJ9MNB2UayzkDCY537","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"It's `search.html`, not `/search`. Every public page ends in `.html` so that it works as a plain file on GitHub Pages, and `/search` gives a 404. You can also get there by clicking **Search posts and pages** on the home page.\n\n| Where | URL |\n|---|---|\n| Dev server (`uv run cms serve`) | http://localhost:8000/search.html |\n| Local preview of the published site | Run `uv run cms publish`, then `python3 -m http.server -d site 8001`, then open http://localhost:8001/search.html |\n| Live on GitHub Pages | https://rajan-thakur.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/search.html, but only after you publish and deploy (below) |\n\n**How it works:** type a word and matching Posts and Pages appear as you type. If you type more than one word, a result has to contain all of them. A search matches a title or the first ~160 characters of a body; drafts never show up. The words also go into the address, as in `search.html?q=robotics`, so you can bookmark or share a search, and Back from a result returns to the list.\n\n**Three things to know:**\n- **The live site doesn't have search yet.** Pages still serves your last deploy. Run `uv run cms publish` and then `uv run cms deploy`, then allow up to 10 minutes.\n- **Don't open `site/search.html` by double-clicking it.** The browser blocks the page from reading its index when it's opened as a file. The page will say \"Search is unavailable: the search index didn't load.\" Use the `http.server` preview instead; the judge does the same.\n- **There's no search in the admin console.** The manual leaves that out of F5, so search is only on the public site."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":533,"cache_read_input_tokens":231211,"output_tokens":547,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":533,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":547,"cache_read_input_tokens":231211,"cache_creation_input_tokens":533,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":533},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"serverClassifierRequest":"4e5639a1-1874-4bd5-9131-0640105c0d51","apiBlockIndex":0,"requestId":"req_011CgErJ93GDVnCaDgeHxW2u","requestRef":"e690b1eb-eb81-42f9-8365-94cbef6f3843","requestedModel":"claude-opus-5-5","type":"assistant","uuid":"d6c42a3f-b6f6-4dcc-90c4-af30cbfb8d2a","timestamp":"2026-10-21T05:44:06.855Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"xhigh","perTurnEffort":"xhigh","session_id":"46a8d74b-d860-4909-a43f-d4dbcfcc3476","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"28e2330c-52aa-4363-b1f2-19829f0a52ed","version":"2.1.305","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"56c96ebf-099b-41c4-993f-3aab5c6d9786","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"8141d4db-32f4-4be7-b382-34f8006277f4","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01WSHLX72td2CJkKwsKiqKyc","type":"tool_result","content":"#### F8 Switchable theme (7 pts, about 35–50 min)\n- **Goal.** Your client changes the site's look without a developer. Two themes, each one CSS file, are selectable on the admin Settings page, and `cms publish` exports the selected one.\n- **Prerequisites.** MP2 done and Part 0 complete. Shares the Settings page with F7 (see F7). The template keeps its CSS as a string in `app/publish.py`; this exercise moves it into a theme file.\n- **Roles.** The Settings page: admin only.\n\n**Steps.**\n1. Create the issue (runbook 1), title `MP2plus F8: Switchable theme`; then `echo T<issue#> > .claude/state/phase`.\n2. `/clear`, then the prompt below with your issue number. Then `rm cms.db && uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py`, then walk the acceptance checklist yourself; fix what fails.\n3. `/code-review`, then the close-out message (runbook 5). `gh issue view <issue#>` shows CLOSED, with your comment above the close.\n4. Save `docs/screenshots/mp2plus-theme-1280.png` and `mp2plus-theme-390.png`: the home page in the second theme. Then run the two checks (runbook 8).\n\n**Prompt.**\n```text\n/implement #N Switchable theme, CSS only. Follow the issue's acceptance checklist exactly. Move the CSS out of app/publish.py into app/themes/<name>/style.css and add a second theme. The theme is chosen on an admin-only Settings page at /admin/settings, stored in a settings table; build that page if it does not exist yet. cms publish writes the selected theme's CSS as site/style.css. Check both themes at 390 px wide. Rules: no href=\"/ or src=\"/ in any template, admin pages included; use url_for or relative links. Every new form carries a CSRF token and refuses a POST without it. Every new setting gets a line in .env.example. If you change the database schema, keep scripts/seed_demo.py running clean from .env.example and tell me to run rm cms.db && uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py. Tests that existed before may only gain cases; ask me before changing an existing assertion. Put the new tests in tests/test_theme.py and name each one test_step<k>_<what> after the acceptance step it checks. Ask before adding any dependency.\n```\n**Acceptance checklist.**\n| # | Step | Checked by |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | Two themes exist, each one CSS file in its own folder under `app/themes/` | read |\n| 2 | The admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice survives a server restart | walk, test |\n| 3 | `uv run cms publish` writes the selected theme's CSS as `site/style.css`, so every page's relative stylesheet link still works | publish, test |\n| 4 | Switching back and publishing again restores the first theme's CSS | publish, test |\n| 5 | Both themes show no horizontal overflow at 390 px on the home page and one post | walk |\n| 6 | The Settings form carries a CSRF token; its POST replayed without the token is refused | replay, test |\n\n**The judge runs:** switch the theme; restart the server; publish and compare `site/style.css` with the theme's file; switch back and publish again; check both themes at 390 px; replay the Settings POST without its token.\n- **Out of scope.** Template overrides, theme upload, per-post themes, a visual theme editor.\n- **Deliverables.** The closed issue; `tests/test_theme.py`; `docs/screenshots/mp2plus-theme-1280.png` and `-390.png`; your report row.\n- **Report row.** `| F8 | issue #<n>; tests/test_theme.py; mp2plus-theme-1280.png, mp2plus-theme-390.png |`\n- **Scoring.** Screenshots 1 · Trail 1 · Tests 1 · Function 4 = floor(4 × steps passed ÷ 6). Total 7.\n\n**If it goes wrong.**\n| Symptom | Cause | Fix |\n|---|---|---|\n| Post pages lose their styles | they link `style.css` instead of `../style.css` | keep MP2's relative links; only the file's contents change |\n| `test_t00.py` fails | `render_site` no longer writes `style.css` | always write `site/style.css` |\n=====\n### 1.2 Process (P1–P4)\n\n#### P1 Pull-request workflow (6 pts, about 30–45 min)\n- **Goal.** Ship one change through a branch, a pull request and a review before the merge, the way most teams work.\n- **Prerequisites.** Part 0 complete. P1 carries one change: a feature from this menu (scored as that feature too), or one item from your MP2 feedback's repair list, written as a small issue. A repair earns P1's points only, not MP2 points.\n- **Roles.** No new routes of its own; a carried feature keeps its own Roles line.\n\n**Steps.**\n1. Create the issue first. For a feature, that feature's step 1. For a repair: `gh issue create --label stretch --title \"MP2plus P1: <the repair>\"`, body = two to four acceptance steps, then `Blocked by: none`. Set the phase: `echo T<issue#> > .claude/state/phase` for a feature, `echo P1 > .claude/state/phase` for a repair.\n2. Branch: `git switch main && git pull && git switch -c mp2plus-<slug>`.\n3. `/clear`, then the feature's prompt or the prompt below; let it commit on the branch.\n4. `git push -u origin mp2plus-<slug>`, then `gh pr create --title \"MP2plus P1: <the change>\" --body \"Closes #<issue#>\"`.\n5. `/code-review`, then: `Post the code-review findings and how each was resolved as a comment on pull request #<pr#>, then commit and push the fixes to this branch.`\n6. `gh pr merge <pr#> --merge --delete-branch`, then `git switch main && git pull` and `gh issue view <issue#>`. **Expected:** CLOSED, closed by your pull request, with the review comment on the PR dated before the merge.\n\n**Prompt.** For a repair (a feature uses its own prompt):\n```text\n/implement #N <the repair, in one sentence>. It refers to the manual by line number rather than copying it, and the next session should start with it.\n\nYour T22 commit (`50ff385`) is pushed and #22 closed at 05:54Z, with both findings comments above the close. The working tree is clean.\n\n**What matters most for F8 with P1:**\n- **The order of steps is what P1 grades.** It scores GitHub timestamps:\n  1. Create the issue (it will be #23) before the branch's first push.\n  2. Work on branch `mp2plus-theme` and open the PR (#24) with `Closes #23` in its body.\n  3. Post the review findings on the PR before the merge.\n  4. Push at least one fix commit after that comment.\n  5. Merge, which closes the issue.\n\n  Step 4 is the reverse of F5, where I fixed everything before posting the comment.\n- **Don't run the manual's `rm cms.db` step on your real database.** It holds the client site. The new settings table can be added without wiping anything; back up `cms.db` instead.\n- **The next session should ask you four things before coding:**\n  - which test seams to use; this time the `cms publish` tests are proposed up front\n  - whether the admin console changes theme too, or only the public site\n  - what the second theme looks like and what it's called\n  - the glossary words for Theme and Settings\n- **Who commits on the branch:** the handoff tells the next session to ask you, since you've been committing yourself and P1's steps assume Claude does.\n- **Code facts it records:**\n  - No Settings page or settings table exists yet.\n  - The stylesheet is read once when the app starts, so switching themes needs a change there.\n  - Five existing tests pin the stylesheet and can only gain cases.\n- **The review touched your real database once.** In F5 the review wrote test rows into your real `cms.db`.
